Then nearly two hundred kids from around the state are at the Tennessee 4H shotgun jamboree. And, a new Colt ProTip with Wyatt Gibson.

amc.us.title: Meet the Fockers
amc.us.description: Now that Greg Focker is "in" with his soon-to-be in-laws, Jack and Dina Byrnes, it looks like smooth sailing for him and his fiancée, Pam. But that's before Pam's parents meet Greg's parents, the Fockers. The hyper-relaxed Fockers and the tightly-wound Byrnes are woefully mismatched from the start, and no matter how hard Greg and Pam try, there is just no bringing their families together. This all adds up to a disastrously funny time of getting to know you.

amc.us.title: Step Brothers

When Brennan's mother and Dale's father marry and move in together, it turns the overgrown boys' world upside down. Their insane rivalry and narcissism pull the new family apart, forcing them to work together to reunite their parents.

amc.us.title: The Karate Kid Part II

In Japan, Miyagi is surprised to discover that his old sweetheart, Yukie, has remained single. Meanwhile, Daniel is attracted to Yukie's niece, Kumiko. But romance must be put on hold while Daniel and Miyagi deal with local bullies and long-harbored grudges.

As Andie starts falling for Blane, she begins to realize that dating someone from a different social sphere is not easy.

amc.us.title: Back to the Future Part III

Fox) obtains a 70-year-old message from the time-traveling Dr. Emmett Brown (Christopher Lloyd), in which he informs Marty that he has retired to a small town in the Old West. Marty then finds out that the Doc was murdered shortly after sending the letter. In order to save his friend, Marty will have to travel back in time, disentangle a lovestruck Doc from a local schoolmarm, and repair the DeLorean -- all while avoiding a posse of gunslingers.

amc.us.title: Back to the Future

Traveling through time in a modified DeLorean car, Marty encounters young versions of his parents, and must make sure that they fall in love, or he'll cease to exist. Even more dauntingly, Marty has to return to his own time and save the life of Doc Brown. (Comedy, Science fiction) - 1985

bouncetv.us.title: Lauren Lake's Paternity Court - Davis vs. Cole

bouncetv.us.title: Lauren Lake's Paternity Court - Johnson vs. Walters
bouncetv.us.description: A traveling salesman had a "fling" with a married woman and is accused of fathering her 2-year-old daughter.

bouncetv.us.description: Althea is at odds with Virgil over his pursuit of a suspected drug dealer because it threatens to break up the home life of one of her students.

bouncetv.us.title: The Expendables
bouncetv.us.description: Mercenary leader Barney Ross and his loyal men take on what they think is a routine assignment: a covert operation to invade the South American country of Vilena and overthrow its dictator. But, when they learn that the job will be a suicide mission, they must choose redemption or the destruction of their brotherhood.

bouncexl.us.title: Parker
bouncexl.us.description: Daring, ruthless and meticulous, Parker (Jason Statham) is one of the most successful thieves in the business. But when his latest robbery turns deadly because of a careless crew member, he declines to join crime boss Melander (Michael Chiklis) and his gang for another heist. The crooks turn on Parker and leave him for dead. Parker survives and vows vengeance, tracing the gang to Palm Beach. There, he joins forces with an unlikely ally (Jennifer Lopez) to hijack the gang's next big score.

bouncexl.us.title: Antwone Fisher
bouncexl.us.description: The touching story of a sailor (Derek Luke) who, prone to violent outbursts, is sent to a naval psychiatrist (Denzel Washington) for help. Refusing at first to open up, the young man eventually breaks down and reveals a horrific childhood. Through the guidance of his new doctor, he confronts his painful past and begins a quest to find the family he never knew.

bouncexl.us.title: The Bernie Mac Show - Starting School
bouncexl.us.description: Bernie is overwhelmed by the task of getting the children ready for their first day of school; Jordan pretends to be sick, Vanessa refuses to come out of the bathroom and Bryana wants to have her hair braided.

bouncexl.us.title: Beyond the Curve With Sanya Richards-Ross - The Gravity Of Greatness
bouncexl.us.description: Olympic sprinter Melissa Jefferson-Wooden joins Sanya Richards-Ross to discuss her formula for becoming the fastest woman in the world and the passions that drive her beyond the track. Plus, media mogul Kandi Burruss opens up about her pivot away from reality television, life after divorce, and how her work on Broadway is helping pave the way for the next generation of creatives.

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

classica.us.title: Heavenly Voices - Farinellis Vermächtnis
classica.us.description: Als "Kastraten" werden männliche Sänger bezeichnet, die mit glockenklarer Stimme Tonhöhen des Soprans erreichen können, weil man sie noch vor dem Stimmbruch kastriert. Die Dokumentation beschäftigt sich mit dem Aufstieg bekannter Kastraten in der Geschichte und den Umständen, die ihre Karriere möglich machten. Außerdem sprechen die zwei Kontratenoren Max Emanuel Cencic und Philippe Jaroussky über die Musikentwicklung im Barock.

classica.us.title: Berg - Klaviersonate, op. 1
classica.us.description: Der italienische Pianist Andrea Molteni spielt Alban Bergs Klaviersonate in h-Moll, Op. 1. Molteni begann mit sechs Jahren mit dem Klavierspiel. Er schloss das Conservatorio di Musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como mit Auszeichnung und Ehrennennung ab.

classica.us.title: Mahler - Sinfonie Nr. 9
classica.us.description: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leitet das Orchester del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino bei einer Aufführung von Gustav Mahlers Symphonie Nr. 9 in D-Dur. Diese Symphonie wurde in den Jahren 1908-1909 geschrieben und war die letzte, die Mahler vollendete.

classica.us.title: Kammermusik von Janáček, Taffanel und Prokofjew
classica.us.description: Unter anderem spielt das Quinteto Zéphyros Leoš Janáčeks Mládí (Jugend) für Bläsersextett. Diese Aufführung wurde am 11. Mai 2024 im Auditorio Sony der Hochschule für Musik Reina Sofía in Madrid, Spanien, für die Übertragung aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Clara Haskil - Das Geheimnis der Interpretin
classica.us.description: Für Freunde und Musiker war und ist die Schweizer Klaviervirtuosin Clara Haskil eine Interpretin, die wie keine andere Maßstäbe gesetzt hat. Anhand von Klaviereinspielungen, Briefen und Interviews zeigt der Film die Musikerin in neuem Licht.

classica.us.title: Copland - Appalachian Spring
classica.us.description: Die Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería spielt in Mexiko-Stadt unter der Leitung des Dirigenten Carlos Miguel Prieto Aaron Coplands "Appalachian Spring Suite". Diese entstammt Coplands 1944 für Martha Graham komponiertem Ballett.

classica.us.title: Bruckner - 7. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: In einem Konzert von 2019 im Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven leitet Dirigent Hartmut Haenchen das Orchester der Philharmonie zuidnederland. Das Konzert dreht sich ganz um Anton Bruckners 7. Sinfonie.

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 2
classica.us.description: Mahlers Auferstehungssinfonie, komponiert zwischen 1888 und 1894, ist ein monumentales Werk in fünf Sätzen, das Themen wie Tod und Auferstehung erforscht.

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 4
classica.us.description: Gustav Mahlers Sinfonie Nr. 4, komponiert zwischen 1899 und 1901, schildert die kindliche Vorstellung vom Himmel, ein zentrales Thema, das den unschuldigen und lyrischen Charakter des Werkes prägt.

classica.us.title: Rachmaninow - 1. Klavierkonzert, Op. 1
classica.us.description: In diesem Konzert wird der Pianist Boris Berezovsky vom Moskauer Philharmonischen Orchester unter der Leitung von Alexander Sladkovsky in einer Aufführung von Rachmaninows Klavierkonzert begleitet.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 5 in c-Moll, op. 67
classica.us.description: Sir Simon Rattle dirigiert das London Symphony Orchestra in einer Aufführung von Ludwig van Beethovens berühmter 5. Symphonie in c-Moll, Op. 67. Hat Beethovens berühmte Fünfte immer noch die Kraft, uns alle zu überraschen?

classica.us.title: Liszts 1. Klavierkonzert & Mahlers 5. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: Michael Tilson Thomas dirigiert das London Symphony Orchestra in einer Aufführung von Franz Liszts Klavierkonzert Nr. 1 in Es-Dur und Gustav Mahlers Sinfonie Nr. 5. Der tschechische Pianist Lukáš Vondráček ist der Solist in Liszts Konzert.

classica.us.title: Bach - 6. Brandenburgisches Konzert
classica.us.description: Bei dieser Aufführung im Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses präsentieren Václav Luks und sein Collegium 1704 Bachs Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 6 in B-Dur, BWV 1051. Im Gegensatz zu den anderen Konzerten gibt es in diesem Stück keine Geigen.

classica.us.title: Welser-Möst dirigiert Farrenc & Mussorgsky/Ravel
classica.us.description: Franz Welser-Möst dirigiert das Cleveland Orchester mit einem Programm, das im März 2023 im Severance Music Center in Cleveland aufgezeichnet wurde. Auf dem Programm sind Louise Farrencs Sinfonie Nr. 3, Ravels Klavierkonzert in G-Dur mit Víkingur.

classica.us.title: Heyward dirigiert Dvořáks Sinfonie Nr. 9
classica.us.description: Es ist eins der beliebtesten Stücke aller Zeiten: Mit der Aufführung von der 9. Sinfonie e-Moll unter dem Namen "Aus der Neuen Welt" von Antonín Dvořáks gibt der amerikanische Dirigent Jonathon Heyward mit dem "London Symphony Orchestra" sein Debüt.

classica.us.title: Danielpour - Elegies
classica.us.description: Hartmut Haenchen leitet das Orchester der Philharmonie zuidnederland in einem Konzert von Richard Danielpours "Elegies". Solisten sind Marina Prudenskaya und Thomas Oliemans. Die Aufnahme entstand 2019 im Muziekgebouw Eindhoven in den Niederlanden.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, op. 55
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Fabio Luisi leitet das Dänische Radio-Sinfonieorchester in einer Aufführung von Beethovens 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, Op. 55. Neben der fantastischen "Eroica" werden auch Strawinskis Psalmensinfonie und Strauss' "Don Juan" interpretiert.

classica.us.title: Schumann - Sinfonische Etüden, op. 13
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwarz Schumanns Symphonische Etüden op. 13. Das zwischen 1834 und 1837 komponierte Werk bestand zunächst aus einem Thema und einer Reihe von sechzehn Variationen. Es wurde von Baron von Fricken komponiert.

cnbc.us.title: Squawk on the Street ᴸᶦᵛᵉ

cnbc.us.title: Halftime Report ᴸᶦᵛᵉ

cnbc.us.title: The Exchange ᴸᶦᵛᵉ

cnbc.us.title: Power Lunch ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
cnbc.us.description: Focusing on real-time market coverage, breaking news and up-to-the-instant stock moving information; delving into the economy, the markets, real estate, media and technology.

cnbc.us.title: Closing Bell ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
cnbc.us.description: A guide through the most important hour of the Wall Street trading day; taking a close-up look at how the markets are moving, what's driving them and how investors are reacting; coverage includes reports from the CME Group, NASDAQ and the NYSE.

cnbc.us.title: Closing Bell: Overtime ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
cnbc.us.description: Melissa Lee and Michael Santoli take viewers through all the after-hours moves including breaking news, corporate earnings and post-market trading; strategists and money managers debate actionable ideas and the market themes of the day.

cnbc.us.title: Fast Money ᴸᶦᵛᵉ

foodnetwork.us.title: Holiday Baking Championship - Chocolate for the Win
foodnetwork.us.description: Jesse Palmer asks the nine remaining bakers to create amazing chocolate chip cookie holiday desserts using Ghirardelli chocolate chips; the best dessert is selected by judges Duff Goldman, Kardea Brown and Molly Yeh to win a $1,000 prize package.

foodnetwork.us.title: Sweet Deceit - Holiday: Christmas Carolers' Tavern
foodnetwork.us.description: Host Josh Peck welcomes three Christmas carolers to a historic holiday tavern, where they hunt for six hyperrealistic cakes created by baker April Julian and disguised as everyday objects; can the singing trio end on a high note and win up to $12,000?

foodnetwork.us.title: Sweet Deceit - Holiday: Yuletide Toy Store
foodnetwork.us.description: Host Josh Peck and cake artist Jose Barajas welcome three busy moms who are expert holiday shoppers; their gift-giving know-how is put to the test as they try to spot the hyperrealistic sweets hidden around a festive holiday toy store to win $12,000!

foodnetwork.us.title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking - Hagrid's Challenge
foodnetwork.us.description: James and Oliver Phelps challenge the teams to recreate edible magical creatures featuring ingredients that could be foraged in the Forbidden Forest; Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain travel to Hagrid's Hut to judge the showpieces, and one team goes home.

foodnetwork.us.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Beat the Boss!
foodnetwork.us.description: Ross Matthews and podcaster Jaymee Sire recruit crew members Matt Skrincosky and Allison Cancro in a unified bid to finally take down their formidable boss, Bobby Flay.

foodnetwork.us.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Are We Having Fun Yet?
foodnetwork.us.description: Carson Kressley teams up with Triple Threat titan Ayesha Nurdjaja as chefs Laurence Louie and Logan Sandoval put Bobby Flay to the test with a dish he's never heard of.

foodnetwork.us.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Fight Like a Lion
foodnetwork.us.description: Eric Adjepong and Jaymee Sire team up with chefs Solomon Johnson and Niema Digrazia to challenge Bobby Flay with a dish from the African Diaspora.

foodnetwork.us.title: Beat Bobby Flay - Don't Yuck My Yum
foodnetwork.us.description: Sunny Anderson and TV host Ross Mathews team up with chefs Kaleena Bliss and Melissa Donahue-Talmadge to boil up a win against Bobby Flay.

foodnetwork.us.title: Kitchen Undercover - Steakhouse Stakeout
foodnetwork.us.description: Ralph, a successful nightclub owner, thought running Buena Mesa steakhouse would be easy; now, Chef Antonia Lofaso sends her sous-chef Nestor Milian undercover to save a filthy, failing restaurant before everything falls apart.

foodnetwork.us.title: Kitchen Undercover - Mission: ImPASTAble
foodnetwork.us.description: Landmark Italian restaurant Ricci's is on the brink. Overwhelmed new owner Edith asks Chef Lofaso and her undercover sous-chef Nestor Milian to expose the chaos before an authentic Italian nonna puts its food, and reputation, to the ultimate test.

foodnetwork.us.title: Alex vs. America - Alex vs Fruit
foodnetwork.us.description: Welcoming three chefs to challenge Alex in a battle for the best fruit dish using ingredients that can give them an advantage with the judges.

foodnetwork.us.title: Alex vs. America - Alex vs Japan
foodnetwork.us.description: Eric invites three Japanese chefs to take on Alex in a competition that's out of her comfort zone; judges Shota Nakajima and Tetsu Yahagi decide if they have what it takes to beat an Iron Chef in her own arena.

foodnetwork.us.title: Alex vs. America - Alex vs Eggs
foodnetwork.us.description: Welcoming three chefs to use their skills with eggs to crack Alex's competition prowess; in a blind judging, Brooke Williamson and Michael Voltaggio.

foodnetwork.us.title: Alex vs. America - Alex vs Frozen Desserts
foodnetwork.us.description: Eric Adjepong challenges three cool treat chefs to take on Alex; Duff Goldman and Natasha Case judge as the chefs try to keep their cool to beat Alex.

foodnetwork.us.title: Chopped - Ted's Takeover
foodnetwork.us.description: Ted is in charge of the baskets; in the first round, he challenges the chefs with a wildly unusual product in a tube and his favorite snack of all time; the final basket includes an exotic extract and an Italian dessert that Ted can never pass up.

foodnetwork.us.title: Chopped - Indigenous Inspiration

fx.us.title: This Means War
fx.us.description: CIA operatives FDR Foster (Chris Pine) and Tuck (Tom Hardy) are inseparable best friends and partners. Together, their good looks, covert abilities and combat skills rank them among the CIA's elite, but their longstanding personal and professional bond is put to the test when they meet Lauren (Reese Witherspoon). FDR and Tuck both fall hard for the beautiful blonde, turning their deadly skills and an array of high-tech gadgetry against each other in an all-out battle for her love.

fx.us.title: There's Something About Mary
fx.us.description: Ted's dream prom date with Mary never happens due to an embarrassing injury at her home. Years later, Ted hires Pat Healy to track down Mary so he can reconnect with her. Pat lies to Ted about Mary, and he finds out everything he can about her to trick her into dating him. Ted travels to meet Mary and has to weave through the web of lies that Pat and Mary's friend Tucker have woven to try and win her over.

fx.us.title: Violent Night
fx.us.description: An elite team of mercenaries breaks into a family compound on Christmas Eve, taking everyone hostage inside. However, they aren't prepared for a surprise combatant: Santa Claus is on the grounds, and he's about to show why this Nick is no saint.

fx.us.title: The Mummy
fx.us.description: The Mummy is a rousing, suspenseful and horrifying epic about an expedition of treasure-seeking explorers in the Sahara Desert in 1925. Stumbling upon an ancient tomb, the hunters unwittingly set loose a 3,000-year-old legacy of terror, which is embodied in the vengeful reincarnation of an Egyptian priest who had been sentenced to an eternity as one of the living dead.

fx.us.title: Doctor Strange
fx.us.description: Dr. Stephen Strange's (Benedict Cumberbatch) life changes after a car accident robs him of the use of his hands. When traditional medicine fails him, he looks for healing, and hope, in a mysterious enclave. He quickly learns that the enclave is at the front line of a battle against unseen dark forces bent on destroying reality. Before long, Strange is forced to choose between his life of fortune and status or leave it all behind to defend the world as the most powerful sorcerer in existence.

fxm.us.title: Morbius
fxm.us.description: Dangerously ill with a rare blood disorder and determined to save others from the same fate, Dr. Morbius attempts a desperate gamble. While at first it seems to be a radical success, a darkness inside of him is soon unleashed.

fxm.us.title: X-Men: Dark Phoenix
fxm.us.description: The X-Men face their most formidable and powerful foe when one of their own, Jean Grey, starts to spiral out of control. During a rescue mission in outer space, Jean is nearly killed when she's hit by a mysterious cosmic force. Once she returns home, this force not only makes her infinitely more powerful, but far more unstable. The X-Men must now band together to save her soul and battle aliens that want to use Grey's new abilities to rule the galaxy.

fxm.us.title: Alien
fxm.us.description: In deep space, the crew of the commercial starship Nostromo is awakened from their cryo-sleep capsules halfway through their journey home to investigate a distress call from an alien vessel. The terror begins when the crew encounters a nest of eggs inside the alien ship. An organism from inside an egg leaps out and attaches itself to one of the crew, causing him to fall into a coma.

fxm.us.title: Fathom
fxm.us.description: While touring abroad in Europe, beautiful American skydiver Fathom Harvill (Raquel Welch) gets wrapped up in international intrigue when Scottish spy Douglas Campbell (Ronald Fraser) recruits her to help him on a secret mission. Before long, Fathom realizes that no one around her, including the mysterious Peter Merriwether (Tony Franciosa), can easily be trusted, leading to various adventures that involve bullfighting, beaches and, of course, romance.

fxm.us.title: Voyage to the Bottom of the Sea
fxm.us.description: Harriman Nelson (Walter Pidgeon) is the creator of a revolutionary nuclear submarine. After testing its capabilities in the Arctic Ocean, Nelson and the commanding officer (Robert Sterling) surface the vessel, only to discover the sky ablaze. Learning that the Van Allen radiation belt has caught fire, Nelson conceives a plan that could save the planet from destruction, but the U.N. shoots it down. Nelson is convinced it will work, but an onboard psychiatrist (Joan Fontaine) questions his sanity.

fxm.us.title: The Neptune Factor
fxm.us.description: When an earthquake on the ocean floor causes an underwater laboratory to fall into a deep trench and places the scientists' lives in peril, Cmdr. Adrian Blake (Ben Gazzara) embarks on a rescue mission in his small experimental submarine. Along with a crew that includes Dr. Leah Jansen (Yvette Mimieux) and diver Don MacKay (Ernest Borgnine), Blake attempts to save the scientists from the unexplored depths, while encountering gigantic sea creatures that threaten their survival.

fxm.us.title: Cocoon
fxm.us.description: Oscar-winning fantasy in which the residents of a Florida rest home get a new lease of life when they stumble across an alien "fountain of youth" in a disused holiday home. Unbeknown to them, aliens have been using the swimming pool in the house to store their cocooned brethren, giving the waters a powerful, rejuvenating quality.

fxm.us.title: Enemy Mine
fxm.us.description: During a war between humans and the reptilian Drac race, spaceship pilot Willis Davidge ends up stranded on an alien world, along with enemy fighter Jeriba Shigan. While both Willis and his Drac counterpart can breathe on the planet, the environment and its creatures are relatively hostile, forcing the two to work together to survive. As time goes by, Willis and Jeriba become unlikely friends, though their unique relationship faces considerable challenges.

fxm.us.title: The Last Full Measure

fxm.us.title: Ad Astra
fxm.us.description: Thirty years ago, Clifford McBride led a voyage into deep space, but the ship and crew were never heard from again. Now his son -- a fearless astronaut -- must embark on a daring mission to Neptune to uncover the truth about his missing father and a mysterious power surge that threatens the stability of the universe.

fxxwest.us.title: Ghostbusters II

But when the ghosts turn on the judge, he issues an order allowing the Ghostbusters to get back to work.

fxxwest.us.title: Ghostbusters

Also joining the team is Patty Tolan, a lifelong New Yorker who knows the city inside and out. Armed with proton packs and plenty of attitude, the four women prepare for an epic battle as more than 1,000 mischievous ghouls descend on Times Square.

How much is acceptable among three contestants in each episode is determined by the "dater," who hears the candidates' intimate secrets and hidden flaws, as well as their attempts to deflect these traits by describing their positive attributes. gameshowcentral.us.title: Mind of a Man
gameshowcentral.us.description: Women have been trying to answer the question of "what do men think" for years. "Mind of a Man" tries to help them figure out what is on the mind of the average guy. Each half-hour episode pits two female contestants against each other as they try to correctly answer questions asked of 100 men. Helping the women along the way is a rotating celebrity panel composed of a mix of men and women who offer opinions. The contestant who is more successful in understanding the mind of a man wins the game and advances to the bonus round, in which she can amass up to $10,000.

gameshowcentral.us.title: Divided
gameshowcentral.us.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything.

gameshowcentral.us.title: Minute to Win It
gameshowcentral.us.description: As a speed skater, Apolo Anton Ohno won a gold medal at the 2006 Winter Olympics for finishing a race within 42 seconds. The contestants on this game show hosted by Ohno have 18 seconds longer than that to complete each task in order to win a quarter of a million dollars as the grand prize. Contestants compete in as many as 10 challenges of increasing difficulty, each with a one-minute time limit, and which utilize everyday household items. Throughout the game contestants have the chance to walk away with any money earned to that point but risk losing the cash if they fail to complete a challenge within the time limit. A competitor who goes all the way and completes all 10 challenges in time, receives the $250,000.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Rematch: Kip Henley vs. Don Donatello
golfpass.us.description: Kip Henley and Don Donatello step back into the spotlight to settle unfinished business; the battleground is Apple Rock Golf Course at Horseshoe Bay Resort in Texas.

golfpass.us.title: Big Break: Where Are They Now? - Don Donatello & Stefanie Kenoyer; Al Del Greco
golfpass.us.description: Don Donatello earned notoriety for his outbursts and antics, but quickly became heralded as a gritty competitor. Appearances on Big Break IV U.S. vs. Europe and Big Break Reunion solidified Donatello as legendary.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 13: Ball Flight Commander
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal demonstrate how to become a ball flight commander. Learn how to hit powerful draws like Rory McIlroy, hit controlled fades like Collin Morikawa and hit the low stinger like Tiger Woods.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 14: The Open
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach the shots made famous by Open Champions at St. Andrews. Learn how to hit powerful draws like Tiger Woods, escape the rough like Seve Ballesteros, and stick wedges like John Daly.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 15: Power Up
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach how to maximize power like the game's longest drivers. Martin explains how baseball and boxing can translate into a more powerful golf swing.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 16: Right or Rubbish
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach the truth behind some of golf's greatest swing myths. Learn how to grip the club properly like Tiger Woods, hit more accurate irons like Padraig Harrington, and use Elvis Presley to add more distance.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 17: Play Like a Champion
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach the skills of golf's greatest champions; how to start the downswing like Jack Nicklaus and improve the swing path like Nick Faldo; guest Sophia Popov shares the drill that helped her win the 2020 AIG Women's Open.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 18: Chip It Close
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal demonstrate Dave Pelz's tip to stop hitting the ground before the ball and a shot around the green used by Open champions.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 19: Pitching Pearls
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach pitching tips from some of golf's greatest champions. Learn how to set up for solid contact like Tiger Woods, hit the flop shot like Raymond Floyd, and spin wedges like Paul Runyan.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 20: Backswing Faults
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal lean on golf's greatest players to cure the biggest backswing faults. Stop excessive leg action like Jack Nicklaus, reduce upper body sway like Arnold Palmer, and improve poor swing plane like Seve Ballesteros.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 21: Copy That Pro
golfpass.us.description: Key parts of the swing golfers should copy from the best players in the world; a backswing move used by Sam Burns; a drill to add distance like Xander Schauffele; a footwork tip that helped Scottie Scheffler.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 22: Need For Speed
golfpass.us.description: How to increase club head speed, ball speed, and other key areas where speed is needed for more distance. Martin Hall brings in one of the worldwide leaders in golf biomechanics for a cutting-edge lesson on practicing at the correct speed.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Game On!

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Pros and Cons

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Hole it Out
golfpass.us.description: Nine remaining contestants spin the wheel for survival and find out how a dogleg will determine who stays and who goes.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Sink or Swim
golfpass.us.description: Distance control is the focus as contestants learn coming up short can send them packing.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Driving Reigns
golfpass.us.description: It all comes down to course management as contestants must hole out from two trouble spots on the course.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - On the Run
golfpass.us.description: After a quick round of "speed golf," contestants face elimination as they use creativity to execute shots from the fairway.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Spell N-E-R-V-E-S
golfpass.us.description: Contestants learn friendships may go by the wayside as they "learn to spell.".

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Choose Your Fate
golfpass.us.description: Each competitor must decide to choose a shot based on her strength or an opponent's weakness. Guessing wrong may send someone home.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Inches Away
golfpass.us.description: Nerves, tension, and bad weather play a game with accuracy and control.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Ultimate Match-Up

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Reality Sinks In

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Smashing Success
golfpass.us.description: The players get down to business and try to avoid being the first contestant eliminated. The show's signature glass panes challenge is played with a new twist, and the contestants learn about Carnoustie's famous Miller Bunker.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Payback
golfpass.us.description: A rush of national pride consumes the players as they tee it up in their first team, match-play competition to determine who's up for elimination, where it's distance control that determines an unlucky player's fate.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Sharpshooters Survive
golfpass.us.description: It's all about accuracy as the contestants test their approach shots and drive for more than just show to stay alive.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Flashback Fortunes
golfpass.us.description: Contestants experience déjà vu as they try to earn immunity from elimination, while an unfortunate few battle gusty winds and attempt to get a handle on distance control.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Steeped in Tradition
golfpass.us.description: Contestants take a surprise field trip to St. Andrews - the bastion of golf - and have to deal with the pressure as an unexpected gallery gathers to watch them perform.

hbocomedy.us.title: Youth - Michael Man
hbocomedy.us.description: Sam tasks Alex with the unpleasant job of winning Malcolm back as a client; Alex leans on Michael during a family dinner.

hbocomedy.us.title: Kate Berlant: Parmesan
hbocomedy.us.description: Seamlessly weaving through personal stories and stream-of-consciousness epiphanies, Kate offers up razor-sharp reflections on everything from the moon, to her destructive relationship to technology, to the evolving nature of sexuality.

hbocomedy.us.title: Chris Fleming: Live at the Palace ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
hbocomedy.us.description: Comedian Chris Fleming bursts onto the screen with a fun and lighthearted blend of skillful storytelling and wild physicality in his first stand-up special; a performer who seamlessly pivots from one everyday topic to another, from Trader Joe's to Oreos, NPR and dog breeds; Fleming bounds across the stage as he shares his unique takes on masculinity, conga lines and more.

hbocomedy.us.title: Josh Johnson: Symphony
hbocomedy.us.description: Debuting original material about the shared experiences as humans, tackling topics like family, religion and relationships through his unique point of view and signature creativity; expecting an original and unforgettable experience, filmed at the Wiltern Theater in Los Angeles.

hbocomedy.us.title: Lil Rel Howery: I Said It. Y'all Thinking It.
hbocomedy.us.description: Lil Rel Howery, actor and comedian, brings his signature storytelling style and spot-on impressions to the Chicago Theater, speaking about fame, fatherhood, and therapy in a satirical way.

hbocomedy.us.title: Fackham Hall
hbocomedy.us.description: Eric Noone begins a forbidden romance with Rose Davenport, the lady of the house at a posh English manor. When an unexpected murder occurs, Eric gets framed, leaving Rose and her family's future uncertain.

hbocomedy.us.title: Spinal Tap II: The End Continues
hbocomedy.us.description: Documentarian Marty DiBergi follows estranged Spinal Tap bandmates David St. Hubbins, Nigel Tufnel and Derek Smalls as they search for a drummer and prepare for a reunion concert in New Orleans. Joined by music royalty Paul McCartney and Elton John, Spinal Tap wrestles with their checkered past to put on a show that they hope will solidify their place in the pantheon of rock 'n' roll.

hbocomedy.us.title: Green Lantern
hbocomedy.us.description: Sworn to preserve intergalactic order, the Green Lantern Corps has existed for centuries. Its newest recruit, Hal Jordan, is the first human to join the ranks. The Green Lanterns have little regard for humans, who have thus far been unable to harness the powers of the ring each member wears. But Jordan, a gifted and cocky test pilot, may be the corps' only hope when a new enemy called Parallax threatens the universal balance of power.

hbocomedy.us.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Dog Days
hbocomedy.us.description: It's summer, and Greg Heffley (Zachary Gordon) is looking forward to playing video games and spending time with his friends. However, Greg's dad (Steve Zahn) has other plans: He's decided that some father-son bonding time is in order. Desperate to prevent his dad from ruining summer vacation, Greg pretends he has a job at a ritzy country club. But Greg's plan backfires, leaving him in the middle of embarrassing mishaps and a camping trip gone wrong.

hbocomedy.us.title: Zombieland
hbocomedy.us.description: Nerdy college student Columbus (Jesse Eisenberg) has survived the plague that has turned mankind into flesh-devouring zombies because he's scared of just about everything. Gun-toting, Twinkie-loving Tallahassee (Woody Harrelson) has no fears. Together, they are about to stare down their most horrifying challenge yet: each other's company. Emma Stone and Abigail Breslin co-star in this double-hitting, head-smashing comedy.

hdnetmovies.us.title: Battle of Britain
hdnetmovies.us.description: At a seminal moment in World War II, British Air Chief Marshal Sir Hugh Dowding (Laurence Olivier) must rally his outnumbered pilots against Hitler's feared Luftwaffe. Besieged by German bombing runs, the Brits counter with an aggressive air campaign of their own. Within months, the Nazis find themselves on the run, thanks to Dowding's tactical genius and the work of talented squadron leaders (Michael Caine, Christopher Plummer) and other brave patriots.

hdnetmovies.us.title: Secret to INDEPENDENT Living!
hdnetmovies.us.description: No more slips or falls! Installation in just ONE Day!

hdnetmovies.us.title: The Aging Brain
hdnetmovies.us.description: Learn what's behind mental decline with age, and how to improve memory, focus and concentration with NeuroQ's Darrin Peterson and Dale Bredesen MD.

hdnetmovies.us.title: Looking for a Medicare Plan?
hdnetmovies.us.description: The Medicare Annual Election Period ends on December 7th. Watch and learn about Humana Medicare Advantage plans.

hdnetmovies.us.title: The Great Escape
hdnetmovies.us.description: Imprisoned during World War II in a German POW camp, a group of Allied soldiers are intent on breaking out, not only to escape, but also to draw Nazi forces away from battle to search for fugitives. Among the prisoners determined to escape are American Captain Virgil Hilts and British Squadron Leader Roger Bartlett. Outwitting their captors by digging a tunnel out of the prison grounds, the soldiers find the stakes much higher when escape becomes a reality.

hdnetmovies.us.title: The Inglorious Bastards
hdnetmovies.us.description: Two officers (Bo Svenson, Ian Bannen) lead military misfits on a mission to steal a Nazi V-2 rocket gyroscope.

hdnetmovies.us.title: White Lightning
hdnetmovies.us.description: Easygoing Arkansas good ol' boy Gator McKlusky (Burt Reynolds) is serving his second federal prison sentence for running moonshine when he learns his straight-arrow college graduate brother and his girlfriend have been murdered. Eager to take down corrupt county sheriff J.C. Connors (Ned Beatty), whom he suspects is behind his brother's death, Gator agrees to a federal attorney's deal that releases him from prison to infiltrate Connors' underground booze-running business.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: Star Trek: Enterprise - Zero Hour
heroesandiconstv.us.description: Archer puts his life on the line in a risky gambit to intercept the superweapon, sneak by the Xindi reptilian aboard, and disarm the weapon from within.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: Walker, Texas Ranger - Blue Movies
heroesandiconstv.us.description: A known mobster names a respected community leader (Howard Keel) as his business associate in money laundering and pornography.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: Renegade - South of 98
heroesandiconstv.us.description: Reno runs into big trouble when he captures a gang member wanted for murder, then can't get out of town because of a damaged bike.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: The Fall Guy - Soldiers of Misfortune
heroesandiconstv.us.description: Colt and Howie track a Green Beret-turned-mercenary (Robert F. Lyons) wanted on weapons charges; guests Cynthia Sikes, J.D. Cannon.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: Nash Bridges - The Partner
heroesandiconstv.us.description: Nash and the SIU team try to stop a vigilante who is killing the criminals that are under investigation.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: Walker, Texas Ranger - On Sacred Ground
heroesandiconstv.us.description: A gang of young Cherokees steals artifacts from museums, claiming they were taken from ancient burial grounds.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: The Rebel - Scalp Hunter
heroesandiconstv.us.description: A man saves Johnny from Apache bandits, then asks for help tracking a renegade Indian.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: Trackdown - The Mistake
heroesandiconstv.us.description: A murderer Hoby freed in error wants to be protected from his victim's vengeful partner.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive - Death Divided by Three
heroesandiconstv.us.description: A woman's past provides a motive for why she murdered her fugitive husband.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive - The Inheritance
heroesandiconstv.us.description: A crooked deputy sheriff thwarts Josh's efforts to locate the son of a dying land baron.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: Cheyenne - Apache Blood
heroesandiconstv.us.description: Cheyenne must answer a kidnapping with a killing in order to correct a blind injustice.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: The High Chaparral - The Deceivers
heroesandiconstv.us.description: The daughter (Bonnie Bedelia) of a half-Apache man (Robert Loggia) helps him escape after he is nabbed for raiding the ranch.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: MacGyver - Deathlock
heroesandiconstv.us.description: A double agent uses sophisticated electronic equipment in an effort to silence MacGyver.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: The A-Team - The Big Squeeze
heroesandiconstv.us.description: The team works from a pub to stop a loan shark (Joseph Sirola) from terrorizing small businesses; guest Wings Hauser.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: JAG - Angels 30
heroesandiconstv.us.description: A pilot submits his resignation after claiming to have heard a voice that told him not to fire on an Iraqi fighter.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: JAG - Mr. Rabb Goes to Washington
heroesandiconstv.us.description: Harm is assigned to a congressional committee investigating a TV reporter's story that accuses U.S. forces of using chemical weapons in the Gulf War.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: JAG - People v. Mac
heroesandiconstv.us.description: Harm (David James Elliott) defends a secretive Mac (Catherine Bell) when she is put on trial for a despicable crime.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: JAG - The Black Jet
heroesandiconstv.us.description: Harm and Mac are sent on a covert mission to Iran to recover a downed pilot and his $80 million jet without letting the Iranians know.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: JAG - Jaggle Bells
heroesandiconstv.us.description: The crew gets stuck in the office during a Christmas Eve blizzard; Mac investigates charges of abuse; Bud faces a daunting challenge.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - Felonius Monk
heroesandiconstv.us.description: The team probes the execution-style slayings of four Buddhist monks in their temple; armed with new DNA evidence, Catherine revisits the murder of her best friend.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - Chasing the Bus
heroesandiconstv.us.description: The team probes a deadly tour bus crash, checking out the possibility that it may have been sabotaged.

heroesandiconstv.us.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - Stalker
heroesandiconstv.us.description: When the team investigates a stalker who killed a woman in her home, mounting evidence links the suspect to Nick Stokes.

hgtv.us.title: House Hunters - Houston Engineers at Odds

hgtv.us.description: A 26-year-old attorney lived at home to save for her first place in Washington D.C., and now looks for a small condo downtown, but her mother suggests she could get more space and value from a home located farther away.

hgtv.us.title: House Hunters - Form Over Function in Montgomery, Ala.
hgtv.us.description: A couple who has had to move often for the husband's military career seeks to settle down in Montgomery, Ala., where he wants to downsize to a low-maintenance place, but she wants acreage and major projects to create her dream home.

hgtv.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home - Snowbirds in Florida
hgtv.us.description: An Ohio couple happily starting their retirement wins the lottery again, and this time it's a $5 million score! Now, they're calling on David to find a holiday house in Florida that's near the beach.

hgtv.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home - I Have a Dream
hgtv.us.description: After winning $1 million on a scratcher, a couple's ready to buy their first home in Rocky Mount, N.C.; David's on the hunt for homes full of charm and character.

hgtv.us.description: It's the Final Week, and the teams must finish their home exteriors as they try to add every dollar to their final appraisal; property Brothers Jonathan and Drew Scott arrive to assess the finished homes and crown a new winner!

hgtv.us.title: Property Brothers: Under Pressure - One Address, Two Agendas
hgtv.us.description: Joel and CC thought they had secured the perfect turnkey home, until living in it exposed a layout that frustrates hosting, storage, and each other.

hgtv.us.title: Property Brothers: Under Pressure - Everything for Her
hgtv.us.description: A couple's ready to plant roots in Los Angeles and their priorities are focused on finding the ideal access for their daughter's care; Jonathan and Drew face the pressure of finding a home that gives this family the solid foundation they seek.

hgtv.us.title: Property Brothers: Under Pressure - Enough Already
hgtv.us.description: A couple's ready to buy a home, but they're clashing over her desperation to end the hunt and his careful restraint; with stakes rising and options narrowing, Jonathan and Drew help navigate the hunt to find a balance of ambition and peace of mind.

hgtv.us.title: Home Town - Welcome to Laurel
hgtv.us.description: Ben and Erin help the City of Laurel and the Laurel Housing Authority to convert a historic building into Laurel's first Visitor's Center; they also take on the restoration of a 1940s public housing unit as part of the exhibit.

hgtv.us.title: Home Town - Mediterranean Vibes
hgtv.us.description: A couple with an appreciation for character homes is looking for something unique with an outdoor kitchen and a pottery studio; Ben and Erin present a more traditional home set across from a park and a ranch-style house with a garden room.

hgtv.us.title: Home Town - Unfinished Business
hgtv.us.description: Ben and Erin return to help the siblings with phase two of a renovation; the project unfortunately stalled after their father passed away but now, the Napiers are back to help finish the house.

hgtv.us.title: Home Town - Surprises Lurking Beneath
hgtv.us.description: Erin's high school friend is ready to leave her childhood home for a new chapter with her family; they ask Ben and Erin to turn a dated, well-preserved house into a southern-inspired forever home, but surprises lurk beneath the surface.

hgtv.us.description: Kamohai and Tristyn track down the owners of a home that's been abandoned for 20 years and purchase it; the house is in a great location but in rough shape with a tree growing through the roof.

hgtv.us.title: Renovation Aloha - Termites to Treasure
hgtv.us.description: Kamohai and Tristyn are led to a neighborhood they've never tackled before and homes that pull at their heartstrings; they want to make a profit in uncharted territory.

hgtv.us.title: Renovation Aloha - Termites, Squatters and Freeways
hgtv.us.description: After a year-long wait, Kamohai and Tristyn face a nightmare after squatters have taken over a property in Waipahu, causing chaos and delays; with a freeway nearby, Tristyn also faces the challenge of designing soundproofing solutions.

hgtv.us.title: Renovation Aloha - Surf Board House
hgtv.us.description: After losing a property on the bay, Kamohai and Tristyn find a hidden gem in Kaneohe; the house is small and needs more space, but with its view, the duo transforms the modest home into a blend of nature and island living.

hgtv.us.title: House Hunters - Style Dreams in Decatur
hgtv.us.description: A couple looks to settle down while he finishes his master's degree in Decatur, Georgia. He wants a spacious mid-century modern with character, but she prefers a smaller Spanish style home that won't break the bank.

hgtv.us.title: House Hunters - Firsts in Philly
hgtv.us.description: Childhood sweethearts look to get out of their parents' homes and into a place of their own in the Philadelphia suburbs; it's a hot market, and after losing out on six homes, they have a lot to learn about finding their first home, and each other.

hgtv.us.title: House Hunters - Modest or More in Missouri
hgtv.us.description: An engaged couple wants out of her apartment and into a bigger home to host their blended family in Kansas City, Mo.; she's hoping to come in low on a modest house in the city, but he wants to pay up for a big place farther out in the country.

hgtv.us.title: House Hunters - New Digs in Nashville
hgtv.us.description: A first-time buyer hopes to find a charming old cottage in East Nashville, Tenn.; she has a family friend along on the search, however, who thinks she should consider spending more for a new build with fewer potential problems.

hgtv.us.title: House Hunters - Crib Crunch in Cincinnati
hgtv.us.description: A couple expecting their second child needs a bigger home before the baby arrives in Cincinnati; he wants to stay conservative on both size and price; she's set on having a pool and plenty of room to accommodate her twin sister when she visits.

hgtv.us.title: House Hunters - Atypical in Texas
hgtv.us.description: A non-traditional couple searches for their first home in the Dallas-Forth Worth area of Texas; She wants a gorgeous and polished home that says they've arrived, but he prefers a low-priced fixer they can remodel to be as unique as they are.

history.us.title: History's Greatest Mysteries - The Loch Ness Monster
history.us.description: Despite centuries of sightings and searches, one deep-sea monster remains unidentified; as evidence continues to mount, the mystery endures whether the Loch Ness monster exists.

history.us.title: History's Greatest Mysteries - The Search for Atlantis
history.us.description: It's history's most famous lost city; the island kingdom that's baffled explorers for centuries; some say Atlantis is a myth, while others insist it was a very real place wiped out thousands of years ago.

history.us.title: History's Greatest Mysteries - The Escape of John Wilkes Booth
history.us.description: Booth family members share family lore, and what they believe is evidence of the assassin's escape, passed down through generations.

history.us.title: History's Greatest Mysteries - Area 51
history.us.description: Hidden in the Nevada desert, a top-secret military base remains one of the most heavily restricted sites in the United States; since the 1950s, speculation has swirled about its true purpose-ranging from hiding experimental aircraft and even alien technology; Area 51 keeps its mysteries so closely guarded that not even the president is fully briefed; what is the government really hiding there?

history.us.title: Paid Programming
history.us.description: Paid programming.

history.us.title: Tired of Aging? Super Pill's Secret to Lasting Youth & Vitality!
history.us.description: Tired of feeling old? Discover The Super Pill! 6 elite formulas packed with clinically studied ingredients for revolutionary heart, brain, joint, immune, skin, and eye health. Don't just age-thrive! Unlock your ultimate vitality and well-being today.

history.us.title: Overwhelmed with IRS Debt? Keys to Resolving Tax Debt
history.us.description: See how one company is changing people's lives by helping them put their tax problems to rest.

history.us.title: Paid Programming
history.us.description: Paid programming.

history.us.title: Amazing Facts With Doug Batchelor
history.us.description: Pastor Doug Batchelor reveals facts about biblical events and brings new insight to frequently asked questions in Christianity.

history.us.title: David Jeremiah
history.us.description: In this weekly program, Dr. David Jeremiah delivers practical messages to the congregation at the Shadow Mountain Community Church in San Diego. Also featured is music from the Shadow Mountain Community Church Choir and Orchestra, as well as performances by musical guests that have included Steve Green and Charles Billingsley. Men and women who have been impacted by the Turning Point ministry also share their stories with viewers. During the month of December, "Turning Point" usually features special Christmas programming.

history.us.title: The UnXplained - Mysterious Curses
history.us.description: Throughout history, many have believed that certain places, things, or even people can be tainted with dark curses; ominous lakes that morph into watery graves; paintings and precious stones that bring death and destruction to their keepers.

history.us.title: The UnXplained - Extreme Weather Mysteries
history.us.description: A house that narrowly dodges the path of a tornado; rain that falls from the sky like blood; lightning that follows into the home.

history.us.title: The UnXplained - Vampires and Werewolves
history.us.description: Dracula, Lycaon of Arcadia, the Beast of Gévaudan; these are the names of grotesque monsters who have reared their terrifying heads throughout history, unearthly creatures that thrived on human blood and flesh.

history.us.title: The UnXplained - Lost Civilizations
history.us.description: A look at what could cause once-thriving groups of people to just abandon their great cities, never to return; modern scientific knowledge may be able to help answer the unsolved questions surrounding these lost civilizations.

history.us.title: The UnXplained - Unlocking the Sixth Sense
history.us.description: Whether it's called intuition, clairvoyance, or extrasensory perception, this elusive "sixth sense" defies explanation; can scientists find the secret to unlocking these remarkable gifts?

history.us.title: The UnXplained - Acts of God
history.us.description: Examining various events that are said to have been directed by the hand of the Almighty, such as the Great Flood, the Plagues of Egypt, Sodom and Gomorrah, and Moses parting the Red Sea.

history.us.title: The UnXplained - Sacred Rituals
history.us.description: Throughout human history, many cultures have used sacred rituals to express their spiritual beliefs; there are many rituals that are thought to unlock supernatural powers.

history.us.title: The UnXplained - Secrets of Abandoned Places
history.us.description: From the ancient Babylonians to modern-day urban explorers, mankind has always been fascinated by abandoned places; discovering the allure that draws people to post-apocalyptic landscapes.

history.us.title: The UnXplained - Serial Killer Creatures

justicecentral.us.title: The Verdict With Judge Hatchett
justicecentral.us.description: Judge Glenda Hatchett presided over her self-titled courtroom show from 2000-2008. Now, she returns to the medium with "The Verdict." In the half-hour series, the Atlanta native and former juvenile-court judge rules over small-claims cases brought in front of her. Hatchett's courtroom isn't just about finding someone guilty, though. She also uses her experience dealing with young people and her tough-love approach to help send a message to out-of-control juvenile offenders to try to set them on the right track in their lives.

Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart. The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including multiple Emmy, Peabody and Edward R. Murrow Awards.

The crew members, known as yachties, live aboard the luxurious, privately owned vessels while making sure that their demanding clients' ever-changing needs are met. The yachties share a passion for a job that allows them to visit some of the world's most beautiful places. Each episode features a different group of passengers -- ranging from millionaires to hard-partying friends -- as they head out for a marine adventure. The crews live by the "work hard, play harder" motto that gives them access to exotic perks few people get to experience.

lifetime.us.title: NCIS - Blackwater

lifetime.us.title: David Jeremiah
lifetime.us.description: In this weekly program, Dr. David Jeremiah delivers practical messages to the congregation at the Shadow Mountain Community Church in San Diego. Also featured is music from the Shadow Mountain Community Church Choir and Orchestra, as well as performances by musical guests that have included Steve Green and Charles Billingsley. Men and women who have been impacted by the Turning Point ministry also share their stories with viewers. During the month of December, "Turning Point" usually features special Christmas programming.

lifetime.us.title: Creflo Dollar
lifetime.us.description: Dr. Creflo Dollar ministers to people from all backgrounds with hopes for change; Creflo helps viewers find ways to renew their faith, mind, and spirit; based on the belief that the Bible is the written and inspired Word of God, the show is meant to invoke change in the lives of people across the globe; Creflo and his wife, Taffi, share their vision for everyone to hear the Word and gain understanding of God's love and promises.

lifetime.us.title: Life Today
lifetime.us.description: James Robison was a former preacher who changed directions in his life and began hosting this television show alongside his wife, Betty, in order to reach out to help more people. This daily religious and self-help program welcomes guests who tell how they have successfully overcome difficulties in their lives by following God's word -- with the hope of encouraging others to do the same and look to God for help and guidance in times of need. The Robisons provide viewers with Bible-based advice to help them deal with everyday problems.

lifetime.us.title: Joyce Meyer Enjoying Everyday Life
lifetime.us.description: Noted for her humanitarian ministry efforts to aid suffering people around the world, Bible teacher Joyce Meyer reaches out to both Christians and non-Christians as she illustrates how to make each day better by applying biblical principles to every activity.

logo.us.description: The queens shoot shady presidential campaign ads, throwing their wigs in the ring to become the first drag president of the USA; Vivica A. Fox and Thomas Roberts guest judge.

logo.us.title: Three's Company - Up in the Air
logo.us.description: Jack escorts Janet to a stuffy, formal party.

logo.us.title: Three's Company - Mate for Each Other
logo.us.description: Jack signs up for a computer dating service.

logo.us.title: Three's Company - The Best of Three's Company - Part One
logo.us.description: Lucille Ball is the host of this retrospective of the best scenes from the series' previous episodes.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Little House on the Production Line
magnolianetwork.us.description: The crew takes on a modular build to help a dad who's been raising his three daughters in his parents' in-law suite. Meanwhile, Ashley has the crew crawling up the walls to complete a special project for the little girls.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Not-So-Pleasant Camp on Pleasant Pond
magnolianetwork.us.description: Chase and his team are called in to renovate a neglected camp for a growing family; the unusual footprint proves troublesome when trying to create a second bedroom; outside, the steep slope becomes a challenge just hours before the reveal.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Rebuilding the Old Schoolhouse
magnolianetwork.us.description: Chase and his team hike through the woods of Dedham, Maine, to restore a dilapidated family camp that was once the old schoolhouse; from the swarming bugs to the relentless rain, the team learns nothing will come easy at the old schoolhouse.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - It Takes a Village
magnolianetwork.us.description: Agassiz Village provides underprivileged and at-risk kids an opportunity to experience a camp surrounded by the beauty of Maine; with support from the community, Chase and his team take on the big project with a small budget to help the camp.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Salvage Dawgs - Pickle Mansion
magnolianetwork.us.description: The crew members salvage items from the crumbling Pickle Mansion in Knoxville, Tenn.; the main items of interest are a copper frieze and columns.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Salvage Dawgs - Mine Master's House
magnolianetwork.us.description: In Quakertown, Pa., the crew members seek to reclaim items from an old mine master's house, and they are surprised to find much of the house picked over before they arrive.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Salvage Dawgs - Free Will House
magnolianetwork.us.description: The team travels to Free Will House in Huntington, W. Va., where they salvage a bathtub, a sitz bath and kitchen cabinets; Ted and Mike buy a butter churn; Tay and Mike build a wall TV shutter console in the shop.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Salvage Dawgs - Rural Retreat Historical Society
magnolianetwork.us.description: Mike, Robert and the team travel to the Rural Retreat Historical Society in Rural Retreat, Va.; Mike sets up rigging from the rooftop for an outdoor clock, while Robert salvages a vault door and a bank teller station. Tay and Mike build a day bed.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Barnwood Builders - The 100th Episode
magnolianetwork.us.description: The Barnwood Builders celebrate their 100th episode by looking back at their favorite moments from the series; they share some secrets, some lessons and some hilarious behind-the-scenes moments.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Restoring Galveston - Pelican Paradise
magnolianetwork.us.description: Michael and Ashley transform a property; they make the upstairs a kids play zone and the downstairs an elegant retreat.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Restoring Galveston - Double Lot Cottage
magnolianetwork.us.description: The oversized lot makes this 1920s home a great purchase, but Ashley and Michael must reverse a boring 80s renovation with the historic feel of handcrafted doors, shiplap ceilings and original floors that get a fun checkerboard pattern.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Restoring Galveston - Brick House
magnolianetwork.us.description: The Cordrays tackle one of their most expensive projects ever in a town they both love; close to the beach and parade routes, the brick home exudes class, functionality and becomes one of Michael's favorite projects.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Restoring Galveston - Craftsman Camelback
magnolianetwork.us.description: Camelbacks are not common in Galveston, Texas, but the challenge is to make this one a historic head-turner; the Cordrays transform the attic into a cozy family space and build an outdoor sofa that a Gulf storm can't destroy.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Restoring Galveston - His and Hers
magnolianetwork.us.description: Ashley and Michael let the fun and games begin as they tackle his and hers shotgun homes in a friendly competition to bring style and new life back to these two unique houses located just a couple blocks from the beach.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Restoring Galveston - Old Mill Wedding
magnolianetwork.us.description: Michael and Ashley turn a dilapidated wood mill from 1908 into a wedding venue complete with limestone-like stamped concrete, a wedding arbor, lathe table bar, a grand staircase and two dressing suites.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Siblings Revive a Home on Hatteras Island, NC
magnolianetwork.us.description: Two siblings and their spouses have vacationed together for decades; they are now ready to buy and renovate a vacation house where their whole family can gather together on Hatteras Island, N.C.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - From Lifeless Studs to a Modern Beach House
magnolianetwork.us.description: A Connecticut house flipper is on the hunt for a property with a beach view that he can call his own; after years of renovating houses for others to use, he is ready to find a vacation home that he and his family can escape to for some quality time.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Renovating a York, Maine Family Getaway
magnolianetwork.us.description: A native New Englander who grew up vacationing on the shores of York, Maine, is hoping to achieve his dream of owning a home in town; property in York isn't cheap, but having a place to build memories could be worth dealing with a major renovation.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Renovating to Recreate Memories in Hull, Massachusetts
magnolianetwork.us.description: A single mother who spent her childhood on Nantasket Beach searches for a home along the shores of Hull, Massachusetts; she hopes to find an affordable property she can rehab to create the same cherished memories she had for her children.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Narragansett Bay Renovation
magnolianetwork.us.description: A house flipping couple from San Diego have decided to cross the country to find their very own vacation home along the shores of Narragansett Bay, Rhode Island; they hope this property will provide their daughter lasting memories.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Cutting Costs on the New Jersey Coast
magnolianetwork.us.description: A New Jersey family sets their sights on Ocean County, where canal homes allow residents to enjoy the ocean and the bays created by a barrier island; after years of visiting family and friends, buying a home will give them a place to call their own.

magnolianetwork.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Ambitious Beach Dreams in Corolla, North Carolina
magnolianetwork.us.description: A couple who met along the shores of Corolla, N.C., searches for a home in town they can renovate into their dream vacation getaway, but finding an affordable beach property they can transform on schedule and budget could be a challenge.

msnow.us.title: Way Too Early With Ali Vitali ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
msnow.us.description: Inside-the-beltway political news and critical stories shaping the national conversation.

msnow.us.title: Morning Joe ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
msnow.us.description: Hosts Joe Scarborough, Mika Brzezinski and Willie Geist present in-depth and informed discussions that help drive the day's current political conversation.

msnow.us.title: Money, Power, Politics With Stephanie Ruhle ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
msnow.us.description: Host Stephanie Ruhle brings her business acumen, hard-hitting interview style and original reporting to mornings, helping you understand what's happening today and why it matters; make sense of it all, together.

msnow.us.title: State of Play with Peter Alexander ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
msnow.us.description: Peter Alexander holds those in power accountable, leaning on his years of reporting from the heart of DC to relentlessly push for the answers you need. Because what happens in Washington impacts what happens in your home.

msnow.us.title: On the Line With Alicia Menendez ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
msnow.us.description: Alicia Menendez leads insightful conversations that bring us to a deeper understanding of the day's headlines, focusing on what's at stake for our country and our communities.

msnow.us.title: The Moment With Katy Tur ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
msnow.us.description: Katy Tur cuts through the noise with sharp political analysis, breaking news, and impactful interviews on the stories driving the national conversation.

msnow.us.title: Deadline: White House ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
msnow.us.description: In-depth reporting on political developments and dynamic discussions with leading newsmakers, with insights into complex issues.

msnow.us.title: The Beat With Ari Melber ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
msnow.us.description: Attorney and journalist Ari Melber dives into political and news stories with interviews and original reporting from around the nation.

msnow.us.title: The Weeknight ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
msnow.us.description: Luke Russert, Michael Steele and Symone Sanders Townsend's one-on-one conversations with politicians and newsmakers and the breaking issues of the day.

pop.us.title: Criminal Minds - Ashley

pop.us.description: Prentiss faces her past when the BAU is sent to investigate the murders of prominent businessmen, all of whom are missing their hearts; Prentiss plans a romantic first date with Mendoza, but the evening is cut short by an urgent call from Rossi.

pop.us.title: Criminal Minds - Night Lights

pop.us.description: The BAU team flies to Iowa to investigate the disappearance of three 10-year-old children who appear to have been abducted from their homes, with surveillance video from a park as their only lead to finding the children's whereabouts.

pop.us.title: Criminal Minds - Chameleon
pop.us.description: Rossi questions his actions in the aftermath of a struggle with a serial killer who appears to have outsmarted the BAU.

pop.us.title: Criminal Minds - Sick and Evil
pop.us.description: The BAU investigates a string of murders taking place in supposedly haunted houses in Lewiston, Maine.

pop.us.title: NCIS: New Orleans - Monolith
pop.us.description: When Sebastian is injured while unsuccessfully trying to prevent a kidnapping, NCIS races to find the missing woman and her abductors; the team gets a peek into Agent Carter's personal life.

retroplex.us.title: The Silencer
retroplex.us.description: An FBI agent (Brennan Elliott) must fake his own death to team with an assassin (Michael Dudikoff) and infiltrate a terrorist group.

retroplex.us.title: Double Whammy
retroplex.us.description: Ray Pluto (Denis Leary) has many problems. He is satirized in the tabloids as the "loser cop." His partner (Steve Buscemi) is starting to seem suspiciously attracted to him. A pair of screenwriters (Donald Faison, Keith Nobbs) across the hall keep bugging him for help. The superintendent of his building (Luis Guzmán) is stabbed by hoodlums hired by his own rebellious daughter (Melonie Diaz). To top it off, a sexually aggressive chiropractor (Elizabeth Hurley) may just be Ray's undoing.

retroplex.us.title: The Stranger
retroplex.us.description: Immediately following World War II, ex-Nazi Franz Kindler is living under a false identity as a teacher in a small Connecticut town, and has even married the headmaster's daughter as part of his cover. But when one of Kindler's old German associates arrives unexpectedly in town, bringing in his wake a sly federal investigator, Kindler resorts to desperate measures to preserve his secret.

retroplex.us.title: Exit the Dragon, Enter the Tiger
retroplex.us.description: A fighter (Bruce Li) finds drug smugglers behind the death of Bruce Lee.

retroplex.us.title: Live!
retroplex.us.description: Documentarian Rex (David Krumholtz) follows ruthless reality television producer Katy Courbet (Eva Mendes), a woman who will stop at nothing to revive the American Broadcasting Network's failing ratings -- and forward her own career. To the dismay of the government, Courbet approves a reality show that will become network television's first foray into snuff. In the first episode, contestants engage in a deadly game of Russian roulette for the chance at a multi-million-dollar cash prize.

retroplex.us.title: Flaming Bullets
retroplex.us.description: A criminal syndicate has been illegally freeing convicts, only to murder them after authorities offer reward money for the fugitives' scalps. Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) are charged with catching the thugs, and they hit upon a plan: Dave will get himself put in jail, the thugs break him free and Tex and Panhandle will arrest them. But, when the criminals realize the Rangers are closing in, things turn deadly.

retroplex.us.title: Rimfire
retroplex.us.description: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

retroplex.us.title: Stars Over Texas
retroplex.us.description: Cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) have come to the end of a tough cattle drive, but, instead of the rancher they were expecting, they're welcomed by his sister, young Terry Lawrence (Shirley Patterson). It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene.

retroplex.us.title: Return of the Lash
retroplex.us.description: Cheyenne Davis (Lash La Rue) comes to the rescue of a group of ranchers who are losing their homes to a gang of malicious outlaws. When Davis and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), capture the outlaws, they collect reward money to distribute to the ranchers. But Fuzzy, who is in charge of delivering it, loses the money as well as his memory. Now it's up to Davis to set things right and prevent land baron Jim Kirby (George Chesebro) from getting his hands on the cash.

retroplex.us.title: Stage to Mesa City
retroplex.us.description: Valiant U.S. Marshal Cheyenne Davis (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his trusty deputy, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are on their way to aid a stagecoach owner who is mired in financial burdens. But, when they arrive and discover he's been murdered, the loyal pair are asked by Margie (Jennifer Holt), his daughter, to seek out his killers and make them pay for their vile crime. The investigation soon leads them to a sneering lawyer (Marshall Reed), who has a mysterious boss.

retroplex.us.title: Blue Steel
retroplex.us.description: Undercover federal marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is suspected by the local sheriff, Jake (George Hayes), of stealing the town's payroll, but his suspicions are sidelined when young Betty Mason (Eleanor Hunt) announces that her father, an important businessman, has been murdered. Without him, supplies will not reach town, and homesteaders will starve. When town leader Malgrove (Edward Peil) offers to buy the locals out, John and Jake get suspicious, and uncover a land-grabbing conspiracy.

shoxbetwest.us.description: A former cop who has been imprisoned for murdering the psychopath who killed his family, Parker Barnes (Denzel Washington) is recruited to test out a new virtual-reality program where the goal is to apprehend a computer-generated being called SID 6.7 (Russell Crowe), who has been modeled on hundreds of deranged criminals. When SID manages to escape into the real world, Barnes must capture or destroy him before the soulless entity can go on a killing spree.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Attica

shoxbetwest.us.title: After Innocence
shoxbetwest.us.description: Following the stories of seven exonerated prisoners, "After Innocence" documents how DNA evidence led to the release of these wrongfully imprisoned, innocent men. Free after years -- and in some cases decades -- behind bars and on death row, these men struggle to transition back into society with inadequate support from the judicial system that wronged them. "After Innocence" brings to light flaws in the criminal justice system and the need for reform.

shoxbetwest.us.description: A chronicle of how decades of troubled relations between the LAPD and the African-American community served as the prelude to the 1992 Los Angeles uprising.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Breathe
shoxbetwest.us.description: Maya and her young daughter, Zora, are forced to live underground when Earth is left uninhabitable due to a lack of oxygen. When a mysterious couple arrive and claim to know the fate of Maya's husband, she tentatively agrees to let them into the bunker. However, mother and daughter soon find themselves in a fight for survival when the truth about the strangers comes to light.
