smithsonianchannel.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska - Live and Let Fly
smithsonianchannel.us.description: A lone bush pilot races to stock ultra-marathon checkpoints; a heli pilot risks a sling-load at 4,000 feet and comes inches from disaster; a vintage DC-3 plane is a village's only lifeline as a storm closes in.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Aerial Mexico - The Timeless South
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Southern Mexico stretches from Yucatán's crystal-clear cenotes to the fertile land of the Oaxaca Valley; Maya and Zapotec traditions live through gastronomy and art; history is ever present in ancient pyramids and architecture.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Planes That Changed History - Beluga
smithsonianchannel.us.description: The Airbus BelugaXL is a gravity-defying giant; its incredible engineering allows it to fly oversized cargo across Europe, and it remains one of the biggest aircraft in commercial service.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska - Live and Let Fly
smithsonianchannel.us.description: A lone bush pilot races to stock ultra-marathon checkpoints; a heli pilot risks a sling-load at 4,000 feet and comes inches from disaster; a vintage DC-3 plane is a village's only lifeline as a storm closes in.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: How Did They Build That? - Riverparks & Artworks
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Traveling to New York, Denver and Nice, France to visit Little Island, the Denver Museum of Art and La Tête Carrée; the secrets to how they were built are revealed.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: How Did They Fix That? - Fixing For A Fight: U.S. Army Mega Repair Base
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Mike works with the U.S. Army in Germany inside the massive fix facility the MAK, Maintenance Activity Kaiserslautern, as teams repair over one hundred Bradley fighting vehicles, then embeds with troops in a massive two-week-long battle exercise.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: World's Most Scenic River Journeys - The Yukon
smithsonianchannel.us.description: A journey down one of the wild rivers in the world, the Yukon; the unusual trip starts in an aircraft piloted by a painter and the odyssey ends with a visit to a graveyard of disintegrating rear-wheel steamers.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Mysteries From Above - Mysterious Monuments
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Traipsing along ancient pathways crisscrossing Easter Island; finding gigantic designs carved into Asia's Eastern Steppe; ascending a tall pyramid rising from Antarctica's icy landscape.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Extreme Weather Salvage - Savage Salvage
smithsonianchannel.us.description: John Ward and his crew are called to salvage a massive barge upturned by a storm in a canal; Hickory Scuba Divers work to salvage a valuable sailboat that's sunk at its mooring.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: World's Most Scenic River Journeys - The Yukon
smithsonianchannel.us.description: A journey down one of the wild rivers in the world, the Yukon; the unusual trip starts in an aircraft piloted by a painter and the odyssey ends with a visit to a graveyard of disintegrating rear-wheel steamers.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Mysteries From Above - Mysterious Monuments
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Traipsing along ancient pathways crisscrossing Easter Island; finding gigantic designs carved into Asia's Eastern Steppe; ascending a tall pyramid rising from Antarctica's icy landscape.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Extreme Weather Salvage - Savage Salvage
smithsonianchannel.us.description: John Ward and his crew are called to salvage a massive barge upturned by a storm in a canal; Hickory Scuba Divers work to salvage a valuable sailboat that's sunk at its mooring.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: How Did They Build That? - Swamps & Swagger
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Exploring behind-the-scenes of design and construction of revolutionary buildings in Spain, New York and a university campus in Florida.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: How Did They Fix That? - Sealing Nevada's Abandoned Mines
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Nevada has over 40,000 abandoned mines posing dangers; Mike joins contractors for a week to secure five sites; alongside biologists, they explore and document wildlife; reaching these isolated mines requires barges, helicopters and bulldozers.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: The Secret History of World War II - Dunkirk
smithsonianchannel.us.description: First-hand accounts, recreations and expert interviews of the battle of Dunkirk, and how soldiers were trapped on the French beach by German forces.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: The Secret History of World War II - D-Day
smithsonianchannel.us.description: First-hand accounts, re-creations and expert interviews of D-Day in 1944, where the Allied Forces of Britain, America, Canada and France attacked German forces on the coast of Normandy, France.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: The Secret History of World War II - Pearl Harbor
smithsonianchannel.us.description: The Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor triggers the U.S. entering WWII; we reveal the secret stories behind the battle such as that of Dorie Miller.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: The Secret History of World War II - The Battle of Britain
smithsonianchannel.us.description: There are many stories behind the 1940 Battle of Britain, like pilot Bill Millington who sacrifices himself to save civilians.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: The Secret History of World War II - The Blitz
smithsonianchannel.us.description: The tales behind the Blitz; the employment of German speaking radio controllers to confuse Luftwaffe pilots; the French spy who helped the RAF.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: The Secret History of World War II - Behind Enemy Lines
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Exploring the many battles fought out on the banks of the Rhine in 1944 and the secrets behind the lines of the battleground.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: America's Hidden Stories - Forged in Slavery
smithsonianchannel.us.description: The discovery of a pre-Civil War cemetery of enslaved ironworkers provides new insights into the role African-Americans played in the Industrial Revolution.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That? - Family Fleet
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: At a Norfolk shipyard, crews repair tugboats, troubleshoot a massive travel lift and dry-dock a 270-foot Coast Guard cutter while working against tight deadlines, heavy machinery and rising winds. Family Fleet - S05E06

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That? - Sink Or Swim
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: Mike is in Indonesia, where sinking Jakarta battles floods with seawalls, pumps and reservoirs, while the new capital Nusantara is being built as a sponge city designed to absorb, store and reuse water instead of fighting it. Sink Or Swim - S05E07

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters - Headline News
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: Three devastating crashes make front-page news around the globe; the media frenzy puts intense pressure on investigators to uncover the causes. Headline News - S20E01

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters - Rookie Errors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: History's most terrifying air disasters, and the investigations that followed, are revisited and reexamined. Rookie Errors - S20E02

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters - Fight to the Finish
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: Three flight crews face impossible odds: a Boeing 707 loses engines over the Alps as fire spreads, Air Astana 1388 goes out of control over Portugal, and a bomb on PA 434 severs control cables and blasts a hole in the fuselage. Fight to the Finish - S23E02

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters - Out of Sight
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: In one of the world's busiest airports, a large passenger plane crashes into a smaller one; a 1986 midair crash between planes near Los Angeles brings attention to disturbing congestion at airports. Out of Sight - S07E07

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters - Fuel Trouble
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: Three mysterious accidents send investigators hunting for clues; in the end, all three trails lead back to the same source -- the fuel tank. Fuel Trouble - S20E05

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters - Fire Fight
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: A mechanical problem aboard an Air Canada plane turns into an all-out emergency six miles in the air. Fire Fight - S07E03

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters - Impossible Landing
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: A look at the fate of United Airlines Flight 232 which crashed into Sioux City's runway in 1989; it caused a subsequent explosion that left 111 people dead. Impossible Landing - S03E04

smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: The Paul Gauguin offers five-star luxury while sailing near the coral reefs, mountainous islands and tropical playgrounds of French Polynesia. Paul Gauguin - S01E01

smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: New luxury liner Le Soleal navigates the uncharted waters of Indonesia to give her passengers one-of-a-kind encounters at exotic destinations. Le Soléal - S01E02

smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: Facing Australia's fierce heat, Celebrity Solstice provides guests with views of waterfalls, jumping crocodiles, koalas and the Great Barrier Reef. Celebrity Solstice - S01E04

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Trains - Kiwi Rail
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: Two magnificent journeys with New Zealand's KiwiRail: the TranzAlpine, a five-hour journey across 223 kilometers, and Northern Explorer, an 11-hour trip through five unique regions of the North Island. Kiwi Rail - S02E05

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Mighty Ships - Crystal Serenity
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: The world's top cruise ship, the Crystal Serenity visits Sydney harbor, the port of Melbourne, Bali, a large-scale furniture load in Semarang, Indonesia and the port of Singapore. Crystal Serenity - S06E01

smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: Japan's Tōkaidō Shinkansen, known as the bullet train, operates on a dedicated railway line at up to 177 mph. The Shinkansen - S01E02

spectrumoc16.us.title: Lanai's Travel Club

spectrumoc16.us.title: Ultimate Japan

spectrumoc16.us.description: The Dut's Papio Challenge at Kaneohe Bay. Cub Scouts learn about Hawaiian fishponds. Flashbombs catch the attention of menpachi at night. How to prevent twisted lines, a papio and ulua recipe, and an option to replace a rusting trailer bracket.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Flhi Girlz
spectrumoc16.us.description: Check out the 49th Annual North Shore Menehune Surfing Championships in Haleiwa and highlights from the WSL tour events; meet award-winning surf and ocean photographer Christa Funk.

spectrumoc16.us.title: The Champ Show

spectrumoc16.us.title: Cookin' With Cutty
spectrumoc16.us.description: Cutty meets a group of kids who give back to their community in very special ways. This inspires everyone to donate to a local charity who provides free meals to those in need. After yoga, kids prepare homemade salad dressing from local ingredients.

spectrumoc16.us.description: Behind-the-scenes of how the show is made, off-the-beaten-path splashes, a rescue of an unusual creature, and Kawika's favorite adventures. Plus insights from a UH Hilo student and a treasured Hawaii Island kupuna.

spectrumoc16.us.title: It's an Island Thing
spectrumoc16.us.description: Ki ho'alu master Kawika Kahiapo joins Lanai and Brook in the studio to talk about his music career, the awards and his passion for cooking.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Cooking Hawaiian Style
spectrumoc16.us.description: Dr. Jamee Miller, co-founder of Ekolu Mea Nui, leads a Native Hawaiian ohana-led nonprofit transforming Hawaii's justice system through cultural practices, including healing through farming at Ho'iwai. A proud mom and tutu, she shares family recipes.

spectrumoc16.us.description: After the Kona Low floods, attention turns to protecting communities from future flooding. In the forest with Ko?olau Mountains Watershed Partnership, see how crews control invasive trees, protect native forests and restore stream corridors.

spectrumoc16.us.description: The Suzuis will visit one of Okinawa's popular marketplaces, Heiwa Dori. They will be showing Okinawan souvenirs, have delicious seafood prepared right in front of their eyes, and talk with Grant Murata, one of Hawaii's top Okinawan musicians.

spectrumoc16.us.description: When you talk about poke you can't help but mention Sam Choy in the conversation. The beloved chef, restaurateur, television personality and James Beard Award-winner shares his recipe for Mediterranean Ahi Poke.

spectrumoc16.us.description: Remember Kikaida? The Japanese superhero is back in Hawaii, or at least a replica of his motorcycle is.

spectrumoc16.us.description: Marissa Anzai from Market City BFC makes a festive ribbon swag. Pua Cockett from Celebrations creates a beautiful fall wreath. Joy demonstrates how to sponge paint a cute snowman ornament.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Heartland Waterfowl - El Dorado
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Heartland Waterfowl travels south of the border to hunt with Paul Anderson and Jose Aleman in Old Mexico at El Dorado Outfitters for the best wing shooting in the world.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Ducks Unlimited - Cornhusker Mallard Madness
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Co-Host Jim Ronquest and our cameras join fellow Drake Waterfowl teammates Justin Carpenter and Mike Anderson near Nebraska's North Platte River for a few epic morning hunts.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Whitetail Fix - A Season's Worth of Work!
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Jose puts in the work leading to heart-pounding experiences with giant whitetails that push his grit and determination to the limit.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Roger Raglin Outdoors - The Big Surprise part 1
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Roger and Josh Raglin take great free-range bucks in the hill country near Junction, Texas.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: The Wild Outdoors - Iowa Pt. 1
sportsmanchannel.us.description: We're in Iowa with Wyatt for his 2026 season, a new buck shows up and he puts together a game plan.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Dead Meat - It's Not All Good
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Scott Leysath takes a look back at the first five seasons of "Dead Meat" and features the good, the bad, and the slimy; the journey is full of surprises, but they aren't all good.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Trijicon's World of Sports Afield - Where the Deer and the Antelope Play?
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Host Dave Fulson and Heym's Chris Sells head to New Mexico with each hoping to tag a trophy Pronghorn Antelope.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Hornady's Dark and Dangerous - Laying the Groundwork
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Ralph Delserone begins a lion safari in Nyakasanga, Buzz Charlton continues a quest for the Big Four in Matetsi Unit 6, and PH Dean Kendall gets a tuskless elephant hunt underway.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Army Buck Hunters - Gobbles Along the Way
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Buck hunters don't chase Turkeys unless you're ArmyBuckHunter Patrick!

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Gun Stories - The History of the U.S. Service Rifle
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Joe Mantegna takes a look at the lineage of the rifles armed by our troops over the last 150 years.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Jim Shockey's Hunting Adventures - Bow and Arrow or Not in the Yukon
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Jim faces a tough decision as his time starts to run out on his Alaska Yukon Moose hunt. Will he stick with his Bowtech or switch to his TC muzzleloader?

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Into High Country - Hunting Big Axis Deer in Texas
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Jason hunts big Axis Deer and Auodad Rams in the Hill Country of Texas with his girlfriend Tara and good friend Jeff.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Wild Upland - Arizona Quail
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Kali Parmley travels to the desert southwest in search of California quail; these have the distinctive topknot, and are notorious for running hundreds of yards before a flush.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Greg McHale's Wild Yukon - South Island Stories: Tahr Cliffs
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Greg travels to New Zealand's South Island with Exclusive Adventures in search of Bull Tahr; hunting in steep, open country, he faces a new landscape that demands careful movement and long glassing.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Huntworx - Greg, Darek & Max - Missouri Bucks
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Missouri delivers again with two hard-earned bowhunts in one packed episode as Greg and Darek close the distance on a mature buck, and Max Mongrello follows in a separate Missouri hunt.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: The Western Hunter - Border Bust
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Mark Denham is hunting Coues deer in southern Arizona on this public land adventure.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Ranch America - Five Marys
sportsmanchannel.us.description: River learns the incredible story behind Five Marys Ranch and how they have maximized the potential of their family operation.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Everything Eichler - Colorado Waterfowl
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Waterfowl hunting in Colorado may surprise you; Colorado is known for world-class big game hunting, but its waterfowl opportunities are just as impressive.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: MOJO TV - Little Goose on the Bay
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Nate and Jared hunt Pacific Brant with Sergio Alcazar of ALC Global.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Larry Smith Outdoors - The Fish that HIJKCED our Fishing Trip
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Larry fishes the UP with Chris Fish, but one unexpected species hijacks their multi-species fishing trip!

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Two Conchs Adventures - JC and Tucker's Panama Adventure
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Join JC and Tucker as they experience everything that the beautiful country of Panama has to offer.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Legends of the Fall - Kansas Whitetails
sportsmanchannel.us.description: The LOF crew revisits some of their favorite archery hunts from Kansas.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Army Buck Hunters - Gobbles Along the Way
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Buck hunters don't chase Turkeys unless you're ArmyBuckHunter Patrick!

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Duck Camp Dinners - Ducks galore and country music on the hill
sportsmanchannel.us.description: The Red River continues to provide epic hunts and good times in Shreveport.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Bob Redfern's Outdoor Magazine - Lake Ontario Trout
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Outdoor sporting and recreational events for everyone.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: American Made - Stranahan's
sportsmanchannel.us.description: In 1998, a barn fire united volunteer firefighter Jess Graber and brewery owner George Stranahan, sparking a friendship that led to Colorado's first Rocky Mountain Single Malt; Stranahan's uses pure mountain water to craft a whiskey.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Whitetail Properties - Arkansas The Great
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Isn't Arkansas top-notch? Land Specialist Zeke Barrett travels much of the state through the year but ends with the greatest deer hunt.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Hollywood Weapons - We Hear Ya
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Larry and Terry test several requests from viewers, including a bunch of crazy scenes from "Bad Boys 2", "Under Siege", "A License to Kill", and "Bangkok Dangerous."

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Handguns - 1911's Then and Now
sportsmanchannel.us.description: 9mm and double stack offerings are helping the 1911 stay relevant.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Our Way of Life - Halibut

starzcomedy.us.title: Unhitched
starzcomedy.us.description: When writer's block derails the literary dreams of Olly Pickering (Stuart Townsend), he has to move in with his friend Murray (Seth Green) after losing all his money. Things start to look up when Olly's college pal James (Steve John Shepherd) asks him to be the best man at his wedding. Prior to the nuptials, Olly is drawn to a woman whom he thinks is the bride's sister -- only she turns out to be the bride, Sarah (Amy Smart). Can Murray, who dislikes James, help get Sarah and Olly together?

starzcomedy.us.title: Baby on Board
starzcomedy.us.description: A power couple (Jerry O'Connell, Heather Graham) has a surprise pregnancy that throws their lives and careers into a tailspin.

starzcomedy.us.title: Children on Their Birthdays
starzcomedy.us.description: A 13-year-old (Joe Pichler) develops his first crush while his mother begins a romance with a wholesome mechanic.

starzcomedy.us.title: Don't Be a Menace to South Central While Drinking Your Juice in the Hood
starzcomedy.us.description: Innocent young black man Ashtray (Shawn Wayans) is forced to move into a tough Los Angeles slum with his family, including his oddly streetwise, pot-smoking grandma (Helen Martin). Before long, Ashtray's nuclear-armed gangster cousin Loc Dog (Marlon Wayans) introduces him to a bizarrely comic crime underworld. Luckily, Ashtray falls for urban poet Dashiki (Tracey Cherelle Jones), and she convinces him to go straight -- but he must deal with her manic ex-boyfriend Toothpick (Darrel Heath).

starzcomedy.us.title: Lay the Favorite
starzcomedy.us.description: A former stripper's (Rebecca Hall) talent with numbers lands her a job with a professional gambler (Bruce Willis) who runs a sports book in Las Vegas.

starzcomedy.us.title: Failure to Launch
starzcomedy.us.description: A young man (Matthew McConaughey) continues to live at the home of parents who, in desperation to push him out of the nest once and for all, hatch a plan. They hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to assume the mantle of responsibility and get his own place.

starzcomedy.us.title: This Christmas

starzcomedy.us.title: Lovely & Amazing

tnt.us.title: The Year Without a Santa Claus
tnt.us.description: Sidelined by a nasty cold and feeling unneeded, Santa decides not to make his annual Christmas journey. Elves Jingle and Jangle scour the world to find people who still believe, hoping to convince the jolly old elf to make his trip anyway. They run into trouble in Southtown, however, and the only way they can get out of their predicament is to make it snow in the warm climate. From meeting the in-laws to wedding plans with an over-the-top consultant (Martin Short) and his flamboyant assistant (B.D. Wong), it seems as if the troubles never end in this update of the classic Spencer Tracy comedy.

tnt.us.title: Father of the Bride Part II
tnt.us.description: Just when George Banks (Steve Martin) has gotten used to his daughter, Annie (Kimberly Williams), being married, she announces that she's pregnant, making him an impending grandfather. Shaken by nearing this new milestone in his life, George soon has to process even more surprising news -- his wife, Nina (Diane Keaton), is pregnant too. Reeling from these revelations, George gets help from the eccentric Franck (Martin Short), who, conveniently, has moved from planning weddings to baby showers.

tntwest.us.title: Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas
tntwest.us.description: Based on the beloved children's book by Dr. Seuss, "How the Grinch Stole Christmas" follows the exploits of the title character who is infuriated by the celebration he sees down in Whoville each year at Christmastime. He vows to stop it and -- dressed as Santa -- drives a sleigh into town on Christmas Eve, removing all traces of the impending celebration. He watches gleefully from his perch on the mountain above, sure that when the Whos awake and see that their holiday decorations, gifts and feast are gone, they will be sad. To his surprise, the Whos celebrate anyway, leading to an unexpected response from the Grinch.

tntwest.us.title: National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation
tntwest.us.description: As the holidays approach, Clark Griswold (Chevy Chase) wants to have a perfect family Christmas, so he pesters his wife, Ellen (Beverly D'Angelo), and children, as he tries to make sure everything is in line, including the tree and house decorations. However, things go awry quickly. His hick cousin, Eddie (Randy Quaid), and his family show up unplanned and start living in their camper on the Griswold property. Even worse, Clark's employers renege on the holiday bonus he needs.

tntwest.us.title: The Year Without a Santa Claus
tntwest.us.description: Sidelined by a nasty cold and feeling unneeded, Santa decides not to make his annual Christmas journey. Elves Jingle and Jangle scour the world to find people who still believe, hoping to convince the jolly old elf to make his trip anyway. They run into trouble in Southtown, however, and the only way they can get out of their predicament is to make it snow in the warm climate. Meanwhile, Santa sees evidence that people do still believe, and a little girl's touching letter prompts him to pack up the sleigh and head out on his annual trek, making a special stop in the now-snowy Southtown.

tntwest.us.description: Maggie and OA lead the search for an abducted former biological weapons chemist.

tntwest.us.title: Cold Case - The Red and the Blue
tntwest.us.description: The reopening of the case of a male singer's 2000 murder requires Lilly and reluctant Scotty to travel to Knoxville, Tenn., to delve into the country music world.

tntwest.us.title: Cold Case - Knuckle Up
tntwest.us.description: Lilly reopens the 2006 case of a college-bound man's disappearance after his sister finds an Internet video of him in the underground subculture of bare-knuckle brawling.

tntwest.us.title: Charmed - The Lost Picture Show
tntwest.us.description: Paige's plan to get her job back as a social worker changes when her Whitelighter father, Sam (Scott Jaeck), asks for her help with his charge.

tntwest.us.title: Charmed - Battle of the Hexes
tntwest.us.description: Agent Murphy gives the Charmed Ones their first Homeland Security case; Phoebe and Billie discover a belt that gives Billie superpowers.

tntwest.us.title: Charmed - Hulkus Pocus
tntwest.us.description: The Charmed Ones help agent Murphy track a demon who escaped from the government's custody and learn that a virus is causing magical beings to run amok.

tntwest.us.title: Charmed - Vaya Con Leos
tntwest.us.description: When the Angel of Death returns seeking Leo, the Charmed Ones try to use a spell to hide Leo, but it misfires and everyone suddenly looks like Leo.

tntwest.us.title: Charmed - Mr. & Mrs. Witch
tntwest.us.description: Billie unknowingly contacts a demon posing as a human (Sean McDermott); Piper tries to deal with Leo's absence; Paige is able to connect with Henry (Ivan Sergei).

tntwest.us.title: Cold Case - Blackout
tntwest.us.description: When new evidence suggests murder, Lilly and Scotty reopen the 1998 case of a wealthy family matriarch (Donna Mills), whose death was originally ruled an accident.

tntwest.us.title: Cold Case - 8:03 AM
tntwest.us.description: Miller re-examines a case that has haunted her for years as she searches for the link between two murders that happened at the exact same time.

tntwest.us.title: Father of the Bride
tntwest.us.description: George Banks (Steve Martin) and his wife, Nina (Diane Keaton), are the proud parents of Annie (Kimberly Williams), but when she returns from studying abroad and announces that she's engaged, their whole world turns upside down, especially that of overprotective George. From meeting the in-laws to wedding plans with an over-the-top consultant (Martin Short) and his flamboyant assistant (B.D. Wong), it seems as if the troubles never end in this update of the classic Spencer Tracy comedy.

tntwest.us.title: Father of the Bride Part II
tntwest.us.description: Just when George Banks (Steve Martin) has gotten used to his daughter, Annie (Kimberly Williams), being married, she announces that she's pregnant, making him an impending grandfather. Shaken by nearing this new milestone in his life, George soon has to process even more surprising news -- his wife, Nina (Diane Keaton), is pregnant too. Reeling from these revelations, George gets help from the eccentric Franck (Martin Short), who, conveniently, has moved from planning weddings to baby showers.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers
trutv.us.description: This hidden-camera series follows three lifelong friends -- Brian "Q" Quinn, James "Murr" Murray and Sal Vulcano -- who take dares to an outrageous level. Since they were young, the trio have challenged one another to do ridiculous dares in public. On the show, to find out who is best under pressure, the guys compete in awkward and hilarious hidden-camera hijinks and are awarded points for their successes. With the help of a celebrity guest, the episode's loser must endure an embarrassing punishment of epic proportions.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - The Endless Esophagus
trutv.us.description: Sal, Q and Murr kick off another season of antics by getting themselves stuck in a vent system and confusing customers at a bagel shop; our losing Joker will face humiliation in a punishment that's tough to swallow.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Call of the Wild
trutv.us.description: The Jokers are back working as dry cleaners and TV producers, but one of them can't keep it together and must endure concertgoers who have escaped their enclosures.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Facial Awareness
trutv.us.description: The Jokers face off by recording voiceover for a fake video game and playing the concerned parent writing to their kid's school; but one Joker burns out with a punishment that's gotta sting.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Customer Disservice
trutv.us.description: Joey Fatone interviews the Jokers for a fake documentary; the guys react to an overly emotional phone call for an underwhelming reason; one Joker checks out and is forced into being the world's worst grocery store employee in his punishment.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Rage Baiter
trutv.us.description: The Jokers hit the grocery store aisles dressed in absurd disguises, then train someone in using aggressive phone tactics for charity donations; the losing Joker must subject themselves to scientific probing into their hidden emotions.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Mind, Body, Swole
trutv.us.description: The Jokers can't contain the laughs as they answer survey questions for a new snack food and present the world's worst pharmaceutical ads; the loser will work up a sweat in a punishment that's all pain, no gain.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Meat Cute
trutv.us.description: Attention shoppers; the Jokers make mischief by taking unflattering pictures of grocery store patrons, then posing as horrible employees at the Yeti store; tonight's loser must meet his fate in a punishment.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Dopamine Denier
trutv.us.description: The Jokers play unprofessional actors in a fake commercial then make wild assumptions about other mall goers; one Joker breaks and is tasked with becoming the strictest security guard imaginable in his punishment.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Hoop! There It Is!
trutv.us.description: The Jokers pretend to be medical students in training with standardized patient actors, then play the hero and break up a public fight, hoping to earn applause; one Joker has to put his hips where his mouth is and settle a bet of his own making.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Happily Never After
trutv.us.description: The jokers are asking strangers to send an important text to their loved ones and hunting for their missing kid using crazy descriptions.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - A Tight Spot
trutv.us.description: The Jokers hatch horrible revenge schemes on their office bullies, then put one poor contractor through the wringer as they attempt home improvement projects; tonight's loser will be gifted the world's finest douchemobile.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Subscribe to Survive
trutv.us.description: The Jokers are back as wacky inventors pitching a whole new line of AI-themed gadgets; they fill out bogus incident reports with unsuspecting deli customers; the loser will be forced to demonstrate mentally absurd and physically grueling apps.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Me, My Selfie and Eye
trutv.us.description: The Jokers pretend to be bellhops and need to do and say what they're told while assisting unsuspecting guests to their rooms. Then, the guys need to give away tickets to an absurd made-up show they can no longer see.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Haunting of the Joker House
trutv.us.description: The Jokers' mothers visit as overprotective parents meeting a Joker's girlfriend; a Joker must convince a stranger to pose as his girlfriend for a Broadway outing with his mother.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Revenge of the Joker
trutv.us.description: The Jokers are back playing lawyers, trying to convince unsuspecting focus group participants to sign off on ridiculous terms and conditions before they go in. Then they put their family businesses to the test by asking strangers if their radio ad is good to stay on the air. Later, one joker will be getting revenge in an elaborate punishment that the other two are really going to feel.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Vac Attack
trutv.us.description: The Jokers are hitting the floor as restaurant owners of a New York Pizzeria, forced to say and do whatever wacky things the other guys tell them to. Later, they're back at Tompkins Square bagels trying to hunt down a customer that left a scathing review. Then, the losing joker is in for a punishment that really sucks.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Founding Joker
trutv.us.description: The Jokers are back at Colonial Diner, offering some new bizarre specials to unsuspecting patrons; they take a ride through the park; after a nasty fall, the Joker must get park goers to help them out from underneath their bike.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Let's Get Crackin'
trutv.us.description: The Jokers are unsympathetic store managers, forced to throw out a disruptive customer before dealing with the wrath and disdain of fellow patrons; thus the guys must get a bystander to take their side during a heated argument with their fake spouses.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - HellCopter
trutv.us.description: The guys pose as unreceptive receptionists, then head to a world-famous wax museum; tonight's losers are taken on a chopper ride from hell.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Ruffled Feathers
trutv.us.description: The guys conduct focus groups where they try to sell illogical inventions and clash with shoppers at a shoe store.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Stare Master
trutv.us.description: Joe, Sal, Murr and Q play a game of copycat at the park while babysitting children who are being told what to do and say by the other guys; catch and release battle at the supermarket.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - You're Cut Off
trutv.us.description: The guys pose employees at a copy center, then conduct bizarre exit interviews for moviegoers; tonight's big loser becomes the least popular guy at the party.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Statue of Limitations
trutv.us.description: The guys pose as inhospitable restaurant hosts, then beg strangers to babysit their grandfathers; the longest punishment in the show's history.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Brother of the Sisterhood
trutv.us.description: The guys play helpless oddballs in a waiting room, then ask grocery shoppers for cash; tonight's loser becomes the number one enemy of women everywhere.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Dark Side of the Moon
trutv.us.description: The guys make passes at supermarket shoppers, then pose as reporters; with a painfully invasive punishment, tonight's loser is the butt of the joke.

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Whose Phone Is Ringing?
trutv.us.description: Joe, Sal, Q and Murr go face-to-face at a clothing store; the loser crashes a classy book reading, learning that silence is golden.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - The Endless Esophagus
trutvwest.us.description: Sal, Q and Murr kick off another season of antics by getting themselves stuck in a vent system and confusing customers at a bagel shop; our losing Joker will face humiliation in a punishment that's tough to swallow.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Call of the Wild
trutvwest.us.description: The Jokers are back working as dry cleaners and TV producers, but one of them can't keep it together and must endure concertgoers who have escaped their enclosures.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Facial Awareness
trutvwest.us.description: The Jokers face off by recording voiceover for a fake video game and playing the concerned parent writing to their kid's school; but one Joker burns out with a punishment that's gotta sting.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Customer Disservice
trutvwest.us.description: Joey Fatone interviews the Jokers for a fake documentary; the guys react to an overly emotional phone call for an underwhelming reason; one Joker checks out and is forced into being the world's worst grocery store employee in his punishment.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Rage Baiter
trutvwest.us.description: The Jokers hit the grocery store aisles dressed in absurd disguises, then train someone in using aggressive phone tactics for charity donations; the losing Joker must subject themselves to scientific probing into their hidden emotions.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Mind, Body, Swole
trutvwest.us.description: The Jokers can't contain the laughs as they answer survey questions for a new snack food and present the world's worst pharmaceutical ads; the loser will work up a sweat in a punishment that's all pain, no gain.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Meat Cute
trutvwest.us.description: Attention shoppers; the Jokers make mischief by taking unflattering pictures of grocery store patrons, then posing as horrible employees at the Yeti store; tonight's loser must meet his fate in a punishment.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Dopamine Denier
trutvwest.us.description: The Jokers play unprofessional actors in a fake commercial then make wild assumptions about other mall goers; one Joker breaks and is tasked with becoming the strictest security guard imaginable in his punishment.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Hoop! There It Is!
trutvwest.us.description: The Jokers pretend to be medical students in training with standardized patient actors, then play the hero and break up a public fight, hoping to earn applause; one Joker has to put his hips where his mouth is and settle a bet of his own making.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Happily Never After
trutvwest.us.description: The jokers are asking strangers to send an important text to their loved ones and hunting for their missing kid using crazy descriptions.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - A Tight Spot
trutvwest.us.description: The Jokers hatch horrible revenge schemes on their office bullies, then put one poor contractor through the wringer as they attempt home improvement projects; tonight's loser will be gifted the world's finest douchemobile.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Subscribe to Survive
trutvwest.us.description: The Jokers are back as wacky inventors pitching a whole new line of AI-themed gadgets; they fill out bogus incident reports with unsuspecting deli customers; the loser will be forced to demonstrate mentally absurd and physically grueling apps.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Me, My Selfie and Eye
trutvwest.us.description: The Jokers pretend to be bellhops and need to do and say what they're told while assisting unsuspecting guests to their rooms. Then, the guys need to give away tickets to an absurd made-up show they can no longer see.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Haunting of the Joker House
trutvwest.us.description: The Jokers' mothers visit as overprotective parents meeting a Joker's girlfriend; a Joker must convince a stranger to pose as his girlfriend for a Broadway outing with his mother.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Revenge of the Joker
trutvwest.us.description: The Jokers are back playing lawyers, trying to convince unsuspecting focus group participants to sign off on ridiculous terms and conditions before they go in. Then they put their family businesses to the test by asking strangers if their radio ad is good to stay on the air. Later, one joker will be getting revenge in an elaborate punishment that the other two are really going to feel.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Vac Attack
trutvwest.us.description: The Jokers are hitting the floor as restaurant owners of a New York Pizzeria, forced to say and do whatever wacky things the other guys tell them to. Later, they're back at Tompkins Square bagels trying to hunt down a customer that left a scathing review. Then, the losing joker is in for a punishment that really sucks.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Founding Joker
trutvwest.us.description: The Jokers are back at Colonial Diner, offering some new bizarre specials to unsuspecting patrons; they take a ride through the park; after a nasty fall, the Joker must get park goers to help them out from underneath their bike.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Let's Get Crackin'
trutvwest.us.description: The Jokers are unsympathetic store managers, forced to throw out a disruptive customer before dealing with the wrath and disdain of fellow patrons; thus the guys must get a bystander to take their side during a heated argument with their fake spouses.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - HellCopter
trutvwest.us.description: The guys pose as unreceptive receptionists, then head to a world-famous wax museum; tonight's losers are taken on a chopper ride from hell.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Ruffled Feathers
trutvwest.us.description: The guys conduct focus groups where they try to sell illogical inventions and clash with shoppers at a shoe store.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Reveille With Beverly
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: As the substitute host on a morning radio program, former switchboard operator Beverly Ross (Ann Miller) becomes a local sensation when she changes the format to hot boogie-woogie. Wanting to meet the mysterious disc jockey, millionaire Barry Lang (William Wright) switches identities with his chauffeur, Andy Adams (Dick Purcell), so Barry can woo her without revealing his wealth. When Beverly's new job is jeopardized, they team up with soldiers at a nearby military base to save her show.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Hollywood Hotel
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After losing a coveted role in an upcoming film to another actress, screen queen Mona Marshall (Lola Lane) protests by refusing to appear at her current movie's premiere. Her agent discovers struggling actress Virginia Stanton (Rosemary Lane) -- an exact match for Mona -- and sends her to the premiere instead, with young musician Ronnie Bowers (Dick Powell). After various mishaps, including a case of mistaken identity, Ronnie and Virginia struggle to find success in Hollywood.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Ship Ahoy
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Tallulah Winters (Eleanor Powell), a Broadway dancer, is inadvertently involved in a spy plot when she agrees to carry a vital piece of equipment on a cruise to Rio. The spy ringleader got the idea of using an entertainer from a story by eccentric dime magazine writer Merton K. Kibble (Red Skelton) -- whose friend Skip Owens (Bert Lahr) has convinced him to take the cruise as well. Tallulah and Merton hit it off, until Tallulah overhears him discussing a plot for a story and thinks he is a spy.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Du Barry Was a Lady
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this adaptation of a Cole Porter Broadway musical, star singer May wants to marry a rich man, but her heart belongs to a penniless dancer named Alec. Louis Blore, who has just won a fortune through the sweepstakes, promptly marries May. However, after Louis accidentally has a laced drink, he has a fantastic dream in which he, May and Alec are members of the royal French court. Once Louis awakens, he begins to reconsider his relationship with May.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Old Man and the Sea
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An old Cuban fisherman (Spencer Tracy) has not caught anything in 84 days. Despite the devotion of the young boy (Felipe Pazos) who brings him coffee and food, the fisherman fears he has become perpetually unlucky. On his 85th day of fishing, the old man catches a small fish and decides to keep fishing. When one of his multiple fishing lines hooks a large marlin, he decides to not return to shore until he reels in the fish. For two days and nights, the man sits alone, waiting to redeem himself.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Captains Courageous
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When spoiled Harvey Cheyne (Freddie Bartholomew) is suspended from boarding school, his businessman father (Melvyn Douglas) takes him to Europe on a business trip. When the rebellious lad falls overboard from the steamship, he is saved from death by humble fisherman Manuel Fidello (Spencer Tracy) and forced by the captain of the fishing schooner (Lionel Barrymore) to become a low-ranking member of the ship's crew alongside the captain's own son (Mickey Rooney).

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Malaya
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Soon after the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor, cynical former newspaper correspondent John Royer (James Stewart) devises a scheme with his old editor and government agents to return to the Far East and smuggle out a vast amount of rubber for the war effort. Demanding the freedom and company of his ex-friend, Carnahan (Spencer Tracy), whom he betrayed in an exposé years earlier, Royer sails off into the hands of the Japanese with a motley crew, gold and the promise of covert government aid.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Northwest Passage
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An epic Western, about Major Robert Rogers, the tough frontiersman who led a grueling expedition to Canada in 1759 to punish a fearsome Indian tribe and seek a northwest passage to the Pacific. Langdon Towne and Hunk Marriner joined the Rangers at the Indian village, but when they head on to Fort Wentworth, they find the place deserted.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Plymouth Adventure
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Stubborn Capt. Christopher Jones (Spencer Tracy) pilots the historically famous Mayflower on its maiden voyage across the storm-swept Atlantic. Thankfully, a resourceful carpenter (Van Johnson) keeps the weather damage in check. Also among the passengers is Dorothy (Gene Tierney), the wife of the religiously zealous leader of the pilgrims. Jones finds himself drawn to Dorothy, despite her unattainable status. Soon a rivalry between his unsavory crew and the prim and proper pilgrims emerges.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Executive Action
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In 1963, with President John F. Kennedy growing more liberal and humanitarian in his policies, a shadowy cabal of Texas oil magnates, hardline conservatives, intelligence agents and rogue operatives meet to discuss possible action. The swaggering Foster (Robert Ryan) wants JFK dead, but the mysterious and powerful Ferguson (Will Geer) rebuffs the idea. Still, Farrington (Burt Lancaster) carries out a military training operation in preparation for an assassination while he waits for a decision.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Cassandra Crossing
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Terrorists have planted a deadly virus on a transcontinental train. On board are the glamorous Jennifer Chamberlain (Sophia Loren) and her ex-husband, Dr. Jonathan Chamberlain (Richard Harris), as well as Nicole Dressler (Ava Gardner) and her young lover, Robby (Martin Sheen). They can't get off, and one solution proposed is to quarantine them by rerouting the train over the Cassandra Crossing -- an unstable bridge. Dr. Chamberlain wants to save them, but has to battle the terrorists first.

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon

Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates.

(Америка)

(Америка)

Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games skateboard? (Америка)

With software installed allowing him to run their device, the team try every trick up their sleeve to intercept the fraud before the devious criminal can buy himself gift cards.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Escape to the Country
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S26 E41 Dorset Sonali Shah helps Norman and Linda swap London for a breath of fresh sea air in Dorset - and the line-up of properties includes a mystery house that die-hard fans of the show might just recognise. Sonali also takes a break from house hunting to unwind at a rejuvenating seaweed spa.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 Wiltshire - Restoring an RAF Memorial Dominic Chinea and Will Kirk travel to Swindon where a local woodworking group need help repairing an aeroplane-shaped bench that pays tribute to the town's aviation history. Dom meets Tulsi, who brings with her a Hindu holy scripture passed down from her grandmother that's so fragile it can't be opened without further damage being caused and Will learns how to make traditional willow beehives.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Finish Line
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S4 E22 Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz, which sees contestants Laura, Olu, Jack, Jane and Luke race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz, which sees contestants Laura, Olu, Jack, Jane and Luke race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. bbconemidlands.uk.title: Stacey & Joe: In Too Deep

They also visit a Shetland pony sanctuary and soon have their sights set on bringing some miniature ponies home, while Joe's lake project sees them finally releasing fish into the water. Zach has to pass a lifeguarding course before he can leave for his American adventure.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S19 E10 The fourth and final week of heats begins with six new chefs taking on a skills test in which they must fillet a sea bream and use it to create a shellfish risotto, finished with a spinach garnish. Then they serve up a signature dish - knowing that judges Marcus Wareing and Monica Galetti will soon be getting rid of one of them.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: BBC News at Ten

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Tall Tales & Murder

As Matron urges Bunny to give up his boy scout morals and agree to Wesley's demand for a swap, a glimpse back to the 1990s reveals the depth of Bunny and Matron's relationship and throws their dilemma about Maurice into sharp perspective.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Mauritanian
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Biographical drama starring Tahar Rahim and Jodie Foster. In the mid 2000s, US lawyer Nancy Hollander becomes involved in the defence of Mohamedou Ould Slahi, who is being detained in Guantánamo Bay under suspicion of participating in the 9/11 terrorist attacks. Though Hollander initially doubts Slahi's claims of innocence, the evidence in his favour mounts and a series of shocking truths are uncovered.

cinemax.us.title: Shut In
cinemax.us.description: Mary Portman is a widowed child psychologist who lives in isolation in rural Maine. The horrific car accident that killed her husband also left her 18-year-old stepson Stephen in a bedridden, catatonic state, leaving him completely dependent on her. When one of Portman's young patients vanishes without a trace, she becomes convinced that the boy's ghost is now in the house as a dangerous ice storm starts to wreak havoc outside. (Thriller) - 2016

cinemaxaction.us.title: Adult Best Friends
cinemaxaction.us.description: Katie takes her best friend, Delaney, on a nostalgic trip to their childhood hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a chance encounter with a former classmate, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests. (movie) - 2024

cinemaxaction.us.title: Game Night
cinemaxaction.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxaction.us.title: Spring Breakers
cinemaxaction.us.description: College students Candy (Vanessa Hudgens), Faith (Selena Gomez), Brit (Ashley Benson) and Cotty (Rachel Korine) are short of the cash they need for a spring-break trip, so they rob a diner and head down to Florida. However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them. The curvaceous quartet is unexpectedly bailed out by a drug dealer and aspiring rap artist named Alien (James Franco). Soon after, three of the four gal pals decide to join Alien in a life of crime. (movie) - 2012

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Usual Suspects
cinemaxaction.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (movie) - 1995

cinemaxaction.us.title: A Hard Day's Night
cinemaxaction.us.description: The Beatles in their feature film debut, one of the greatest rock-and-roll comedy adventures ever. The film has a fully restored negative and digitally restored soundtrack. The film takes on the just-left-of-reality style of mock-documentary, following "a day in the life" of John, Paul, George, and Ringo as fame takes them by storm. (movie) - 1964

cinemaxaction.us.title: Blood Simple
cinemaxaction.us.description: "Blood Simple" was the first feature film from Joel and Ethan Coen. This is the newly restored and re-edited director's cut of the film, introduced by Mortimer Young. The stylish crime thriller premiered at film festivals in 1984. "Blood Simple" begins deep in the heart of Texas, where a jealous saloon owner hires a cheap divorce detective to kill the saloon owner's younger wife and her bartender lover. But the detective gets a better idea. (movie) - 1984

cinemaxaction.us.title: Isle of Dogs
cinemaxaction.us.description: When, by executive decree, all the canine pets of Megasaki City are exiled to a vast garbage-dump called Trash Island, 12-year-old Atari sets off alone in a miniature Junior-Turbo Prop and flies across the river in search of his bodyguard-dog, Spots. There, with the assistance of a pack of newly-found mongrel friends, he begins an epic journey that will decide the fate and future of the entire Prefecture. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxaction.us.title: Teen Titans GO! See Space Jam
cinemaxaction.us.description: The Teen Titans gang crosses paths with the Nerdlucks from Space Jam. (movie) - 2021

cinemaxaction.us.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
cinemaxaction.us.description: Superstar LeBron James and his young son, Dom, get trapped in digital space by a rogue AI. To get home safely, LeBron teams up with Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against the AI's digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad. (movie) - 2021

cinemaxaction.us.title: Parental Guidance
cinemaxaction.us.description: Minor-league baseball announcer Artie Decker (Billy Crystal) and his wife, Diane (Bette Midler), get to see their only child, Alice (Marisa Tomei), very seldom. To their surprise, Alice and her husband (Tom Everett Scott) ask them to watch their children so they can embark on a trip for work. It promises to be a fun time for all, until the three young ones turn out to be quite a handful for this old-fashioned couple. Artie and Diane may need to bend the rules to make everyone happy in the end. (movie) - 2012

cinemaxaction.us.title: The East
cinemaxaction.us.description: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji. (movie) - 2013

cinemaxaction.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxaction.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxclassics.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (movie) - 1996

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Take the Lead
cinemaxclassics.us.description: When internationally renowned dancer Pierre Dulaine takes a teaching job in a New York City public school, he meets ridicule from the street-wise students, who scoff at the notion of ballroom dancing. Far from being discouraged, he melds their hip-hop moves with his classical style, helping them create a dance form and, in the process, becoming their mentor. (movie) - 2006

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Sweet Dreams
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Aspiring country singer Patsy Cline (Jessica Lange) is resigned to both her thankless gigs and her unhappy marriage, until she meets the charismatic Charlie Dick (Ed Harris). Eventually leaving her husband to marry Charlie, Patsy temporarily shelves her performing career to be a mother. Later she returns to singing and finds success under manager Randy Hughes (David Clennon). Patsy hits a remarkable stride with a string of hit singles, and has become a full-fledged star when tragedy strikes. (movie) - 1985

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Collision Course
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Detroit crime boss Madras hires men to smuggle a top secret, Japanese-made turbocharger into the U.S. But Madras' crooks are murdered, and the turbocharger goes missing. As he searches for the stolen engine, so does straitlaced Tokyo detective Fujitsuka Natsuo. Eventually, local authorities catch wind of the case, and onto the investigation comes brash cop Tony Costas, who must team with his polar opposite, Natsuo, to find the turbocharger. (movie) - 1989

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Godzilla vs. Megalon
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Godzilla and flying cyborg Jet Jaguar meet a giant cockroach and a big black chicken sent by Seatopians. (movie) - 1973

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla
cinemaxclassics.us.description: An Okinawan monster-god helps Godzilla defeat his bionic double. (movie) - 1974

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Rodan
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A bug-eating pterodactyl flies out of a coal mine and wrecks Japan with sonic booms. (movie) - 1957

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Reframed: Next Gen Narratives - A Star Is Born
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Clover must leave her family behind to compete in an algorithm-based singing competition; pressure from the judges leads Clover to doubt herself, but her family's words give her the strength to perform. (Comedy, Drama, Community) - 2025-01-01

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Reframed: Next Gen Narratives - The Prince and the Pauper
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Trapped in a bizarre, bureaucratic afterlife, a famous Mohawk ghost is drawn into an encounter with an identical and partially-deceased descendant. (Comedy, Drama, Community) - 2025-01-01

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Reframed: Next Gen Narratives - The Adventures of Robin Hood
cinemaxclassics.us.description: When a new grocery store opens near her family's bodega and steals their signature recipe, Robina takes justice into her own hands. (Comedy, Drama, Community) - 2025-01-01

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Talk Black
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A timid engineer develops a wild and expressive split personality that helps her stand up to male co-workers. (movie) - 2021

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Gift
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A new short film by Gary T. Smith, "The Gift," tells the story of a college senior who has her world rocked when she finds a homeless girl sleeping in her car on Christmas Eve. (movie) - 2022

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Another Country
cinemaxclassics.us.description: An interracial couple try to raise their child during the racially polarizing times of 1956 Mississippi. (movie) - 2022

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Life After
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A single mother and Indian immigrant travels to New York City to clear out her daughter's apartment. (movie) - 2017

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Walkabout
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Under the pretense of having a picnic, a geologist (John Meillon) takes his teenage daughter (Jenny Agutter) and 6-year-old son (Lucien John) into the Australian outback and attempts to shoot them. When he fails, he turns the gun on himself, and the two city-bred children must contend with harsh wilderness alone. They are saved by a chance encounter with an Aboriginal boy (David Gulpilil) who shows them how to survive and in the process underscores the disharmony between nature and modern life. (movie) - 1971

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (movie) - 1987

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Last Emperor
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This sweeping account of the life of Pu Yi (John Lone), the last emperor of China, follows the leader's tumultuous reign. After being captured by the Red Army as a war criminal in 1950, Pu Yi recalls his childhood from prison. He remembers his lavish youth in the Forbidden City, where he was afforded every luxury but unfortunately sheltered from the outside world and complex political situation surrounding him. As revolution sweeps through China, the world Pu Yi knew is dramatically upended. (movie) - 1987

cinemaxhits.us.title: Papillon
cinemaxhits.us.description: The epic story of Henri Papillon Charrière, a safecracker from the Parisian underworld who is framed for murder and condemned to life in the notorious penal colony on Devil's Island. Determined to regain his freedom, Papillon forms an unlikely alliance with convicted counterfeiter Louis Dega, who in exchange for protection, agrees to finance Papillon's escape. (movie) - 2017

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Way, Way Back
cinemaxhits.us.description: Duncan (Liam James) is an awkward teen who must spend the summer at a beach house with his mother (Toni Collette), her boyfriend, Trent (Steve Carell), and Trent's obnoxious daughter. Trent can't resist badgering Duncan, so the youth steals away to a water park and gets a job that will help him stay off Trent's radar. As Duncan tends to the slides and pools of the aging park, he finds a father figure in wisecracking park manager Owen (Sam Rockwell) at a time when he desperately needs one. (movie) - 2013

cinemaxhits.us.title: Teen Titans GO! See Space Jam
cinemaxhits.us.description: The Teen Titans gang crosses paths with the Nerdlucks from Space Jam. (movie) - 2021

cinemaxhits.us.title: Architecton
cinemaxhits.us.description: A hypnotic, propulsive odyssey through the foundations of the modern world, following mountains as they are turned into concrete and buildings as they are turned into rubble. (movie) - 2024

cinemaxhits.us.title: Broken City
cinemaxhits.us.description: Former cop Billy Taggart (Mark Wahlberg) sees a chance at redemption for past sins when New York City's Mayor Nicolas Hostetler (Russell Crowe) calls on him for a special job. Hostetler thinks his wife, Cathleen (Catherine Zeta-Jones), is having an affair and that it may hurt his chances for re-election. However, a bigger scandal than expected pulls in Billy right at the start of his investigation. Double-crossed by the mayor, Billy begins a relentless quest for justice. (movie) - 2013

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Darkest Minds
cinemaxhits.us.description: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. One of the most powerful young people, Ruby, escapes from her camp and joins a group of runaways who are seeking a safe haven. Betrayed by the adults in power, this newfound family soon realizes that running is not enough -- they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxhits.us.title: Robin Hood
cinemaxhits.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself. (movie) - 2010

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Judge
cinemaxhits.us.description: Hank Palmer (Robert Downey Jr.), a brilliant but shady attorney, returns to his Indiana hometown after learning that his mother has passed away. His arrival triggers renewed tension between himself and his father, Judge Joseph Palmer (Robert Duvall), who makes no secret of his disapproval of Hank's morally ambiguous career. As the lawyer prepares to depart, his father is arrested for a hit-and-run death. Hank takes on his father's defense, despite the objections of the resentful old man. (movie) - 2014

cinemaxhits.us.title: Hidden Figures
cinemaxhits.us.description: Three brilliant African American women at NASA, Katherine Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan and Mary Jackson, serve as the brains behind one of the greatest operations in history, the launch of astronaut John Glenn into orbit, a stunning achievement that restored the nation's confidence, turned around the Space Race and galvanized the world. (movie) - 2016

cinemaxhits.us.title: X-Men: First Class
cinemaxhits.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxwest.us.title: Ocean's Eight
cinemaxwest.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2018

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemaxwest.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

cinemaxwest.us.title: Blair Witch
cinemaxwest.us.description: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined. (Horror, Thriller) - 2016

cinemaxwest.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemaxwest.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

cinemaxwest.us.title: Extraction
cinemaxwest.us.description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. (Thriller, Action) - 2015

cinemaxwest.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. cinemaxwest.us.title: Despicable Me
cinemaxwest.us.description: Supervillain Gru, a man who delights in all things wicked, hatches a plan to steal the moon. Surrounded by an army of little yellow minions and his impenetrable arsenal of weapons and war machines, Gru prepares to vanquish all who stand in his way. However, nothing in his calculations and groundwork has prepared him for his greatest challenge: three adorable orphan girls who want to make him their dad. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2010

cinemaxwest.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
cinemaxwest.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

cinemaxwest.us.title: Pacific Rim Uprising
cinemaxwest.us.description: Jake Pentecost is a once-promising Jaeger pilot whose legendary father gave his life to secure humanity's victory against the monstrous Kaiju. Jake has since abandoned his training only to become caught up in a criminal underworld. But when an even more unstoppable threat is unleashed to tear through cities and bring the world to its knees, Jake is given one last chance by his estranged sister, Mako Mori, to live up to his father's legacy. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2018

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Predator
cinemaxwest.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

cinemaxwest.us.title: Megan Leavey
cinemaxwest.us.description: The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy. (War, Biography, Drama) - 2017

mgmplus.us.title: Yentl

Suspecting a link between the global robot attacks and missing men, Sky Captain and Polly decide to work together. mgmplus.us.title: Marathon Man

Chase is startled when Thiel contacts him, requesting he defend him again. Recklessly agreeing in order to gather evidence against Thiel, Chase is soon dragged into the killer's twisted game. mgmplushits.us.title: Hackers

mgmplushits.us.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers

Besieged by an invisible enemy, Bennell must work quickly before the city is consumed. (Science fiction) - 1978

mgmplushits.us.title: Class

At Skip's urging, the inexperienced Jonathan is emboldened to seek out older women in the cocktail lounges of nearby Chicago, where he meets and beds the alluring Ellen (Jacqueline Bisset), who unfortunately turns out to be Skip's mother. The division between the friends is further deepened when a cheating scandal engulfs the school. (Comedy drama) - 1983

mgmplushits.us.title: Action Point

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Hannibal

Mason Verger (Gary Oldman) remembers Lecter too, and is obsessed with revenge. Verger was Dr. Lecter's sixth victim, and though horribly disfigured, has survived. Verger realizes that to draw the doctor into the open, he must use someone as bait: Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore). (Thriller, Drama) - 2001

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Dressed to Kill

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Kalifornia

To cut costs, they set up a ride-share with strangers, Early Grayce (Brad Pitt) and his girlfriend, Adele Corners (Juliette Lewis). But what they don't know is that Early is a violent sociopath in the middle of his own serial killing spree. (Thriller) - 1993

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
